Would you come here and open your bag for me?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
能過來讓我看看你的背包嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There are many beautiful fish around here. So I feel my heart beating standing here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
這附近有好多漂亮的魚，站在這裡真讓人心潮澎湃。

scripts.text: I think my heart is beating faster...
scripts.translation: 我的心跳好像變快了...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
How come you only know about eating! My heart doesn't only beat for food.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
你怎麼滿腦子只有吃！我的心跳可不只是為了食物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I've studied at a human university before and I learned to speak there so don't treat me like some animal.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我以前在人類的大學念過書，也是在那裡學會說話的，別把我當成普通動物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I am a scholar of fish research.
It's important for cats to research fish.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我是研究魚類的學者。
對貓來說，研究魚類很重要。

scripts.text: How's your research going?
scripts.translation: 你的研究進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I was a good friend of admiral Thomas but our ship hasn't gone back to sea since we arrived here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我以前是托馬斯上將的好朋友，可自從我們來到這裡，船就再也沒出過海。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
The shipmates seem to be pretty lonely.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
船員們似乎都很寂寞。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
A scholar from the university came here to research us and thought it was amazing to find a cat that speaks his language already.
So he's been helping me teach the others.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
有位大學學者來這裡研究我們，發現竟然有隻貓已經會說人類的語言，覺得很不可思議。
從那以後，他就一直幫我教其他貓說話。

scripts.text: Is that why I understand all the cats?
scripts.translation: 所以我才聽得懂所有貓說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Yes, exactly!
I was one of the few cats who could talk to humans before that scholar arrived.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
沒錯！
那位學者來之前，我就是少數能和人類交談的貓之一。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Anyways, now I'm collecting specimens to study the monsters here. I hope you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
總之，我現在正在收集這裡的魔物標本做研究。希望你能幫忙。

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 我能幫你做什麼？

scripts.text: I have to decline.
scripts.translation: 我得拒絕

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, okay. If you change your mind, please come again.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，好吧。改變主意的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There is a monster called a Pouring who's eating all fish in the Octopus and Culvert dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
有種叫水滴波利的魔物，正在章魚洞窟和下水道里把魚吃光。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
It suddenly appeared during the winter, so could you collect the specimens of Unidentified Fish after getting rid of it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
它是在冬天突然出現的。你能打倒它，再收集一些未鑑定魚類標本嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
You can get Unidentified Fish from the Pouring monsters, so please collect 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
打倒水滴波利就能得到未鑑定魚類，請收集30份。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, thank you! I will take these specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，謝謝！這些標本我收下了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I want to give you something, but the last one is out of stock now so I will just write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我本想送你點東西，可最後一份也已經送完了，只好先把你的名字記下來。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I can give you good news even from a distance, but it's only possible if I am really lucky...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
就算隔得很遠，我也可能給你帶來好訊息...不過得看我運氣夠不夠好。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I'm sorry, but please collect 30 Unidentified Fish specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
抱歉，請收集30份未鑑定魚類標本。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, you met admiral Tomas... how was it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，你見到托馬斯上將了...覺得他怎麼樣？

scripts.text: He looks gentle
scripts.translation: 他看起來很溫和

scripts.text: He looks terrible
scripts.translation: 他看起來很糟糕

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Hmm...
Frankly speaking, I was a real fan of Admiral Tomas. Can you take responsibility for your word?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
嗯...
老實說，我可是托馬斯上將的忠實崇拜者。你說這話，敢負責嗎？

scripts.text: Just kidding!
scripts.translation: 我開玩笑的！

scripts.text: Oh yes, he was really terrible!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，他真的很糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
Okay, it really depends on personal taste...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
是嗎？
好吧，看來這確實因人而異...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
I knew you would say so.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
是嗎？
我就知道你會這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Admiral Tomas is a legendary figure who has led all of us in voyaging to this island. I think it was the happiest moment in my life.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
托馬斯上將是帶領我們航海來到這座島的傳奇人物。那是我一生中最幸福的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Please help him a lot. There are not many people to trust. This is my personal request.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
請多幫幫他。能信任的人不多...這是我個人的請求。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
And this is a small gift for looking after admiral Tomas.
^0000ffReceived 200 E Class Coins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
這是送給你的謝禮，謝謝你照顧托馬斯上將。
^0000ff獲得200個E級代幣。^000000

scripts.text: - Can't go next step due to having too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法繼續。 -

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，調查還不夠。
我們得從頭查起。
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像平常一樣胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Are you here to help
or to get help?
You look so weak, haha...
Go and hunt more Porings!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你是來幫忙，還是來求助的？
看起來這麼弱，哈哈...
去多打幾隻波利吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Will you listen my sorrow?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
願意聽聽我的煩惱嗎？

scripts.text: Sure I will.
scripts.translation: 當然願意

scripts.text: No, I won't.
scripts.translation: 不想聽

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
This is a sad story.
As usual, I unpacked the bag
to see strange cats
to show them.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
說來真是個悲傷的故事。
我像往常一樣開啟包裹，想給那些奇怪的貓看看裡面的東西。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
There were lots of cans.
I thougt it was new due to different shape
but it was bad cans!
I ate too much and
got in bed right away
so I can't do anything...
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
裡面有好多罐頭。
我看形狀不一樣，還以為是新品，結果全是壞罐頭！
我吃得太多，馬上就躺倒了，現在什麼都做不了...

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
And by the way, you have...
nice colthes.
I can't let you go,
that hurts me so badly!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
對了，你的衣服...真好看。
我可捨不得讓你走，那會讓我難過死的！

scripts.text: You deserve the pain!
scripts.translation: 痛死活該！

scripts.text: Need help?
scripts.translation: 要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Yes you are!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你說得對！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You know what care is.
Please find the bad provider
and revenge our enemy!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你還挺有同情心的。
去找出那個賣壞罐頭的傢伙，替我們報仇！

scripts.text: No, I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 不，我不想！

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 好，我來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For the peace in Malangdo,
just lay in bed forever.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了綿綿島的和平，你就永遠躺在床上吧。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I will!
I will have your peace first once I get well!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我會的！
等我好了，先讓你嚐嚐“和平”的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Okay, you can do it?
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好，你辦得到嗎？
賣壞罐頭的傢伙應該就在我們拿包裹的碼頭附近。
把他們拉來幫忙，改善貓咪們的生活！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Why are you here!
If I am usual, I will engrave something
with your tear...
Let your bag be here instead!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你怎麼又來了！
要是我狀態正常，早就用你的眼淚刻點什麼了...
把你的背包留下抵賬吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
賣壞罐頭的傢伙應該就在我們拿包裹的碼頭附近。
把他們拉來幫忙，改善貓咪們的生活！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I am so tired due to
lack of forbidden bad activity.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好久沒做那些不該做的壞事了，真沒勁。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Was it from raccoon that made us pain in stomach?
Oh bad raccoon!
I feel stomachache again from this anger!
All right, I will show my power once
I can get out of bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
是浣熊害我們胃疼的嗎？
可惡的浣熊！
我氣得又胃疼了！
等我能下床了，就讓你見識我的厲害。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I need time to concentrate on my stomachache.
You can go now!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我得專心對付胃疼。
你先走吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
How do you know the source of bad can?
Do you have time to do slow at the moment?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你怎麼查到壞罐頭的來源了？
你現在有空慢慢處理這件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The Patrol Leader wants to go back to
bad world as soon as possible.
I want you to go first to soothe him instead.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
巡邏隊長想盡快回到那個糟糕的世界。
你先去安撫一下他吧。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: It's troublsome, I quit.
scripts.translation: 太麻煩了，我不幹了

scripts.text: Sure I will!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Haha, you think it is a bad word.
I want you to be one of our staffs.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
哈哈，你以為我在罵人呢。
我想讓你加入我們，成為一員。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Sorry, but you should go now
so that I can concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
抱歉，你先走吧，
我得專心對付胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
All right, then I will have time
to concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好吧，那我就能專心對付胃疼了。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，調查還不夠。
我們得從頭查起。
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像平常一樣胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Go and have fun with the Patrol Leader!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
去和巡邏隊長玩得開心點吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Instead of us, you did bad behavior.
Good to hear that?
This is what teacher see best pupil?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我們才是做壞事的那一方，你卻搶先做了壞事。
聽了很高興嗎？
這就是老師眼裡的好學生？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You deserve a reward!
I need to get some more rest,
so let's investigate tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你應該得到獎勵！
我得再休息一會兒，明天繼續調查吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像平常一樣胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobulee]
What a time to show up!
You should come around when we're healthy.
scripts.translation:
[戈布利]
真是不巧啊！
等我們身體好些了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Gobyungee]
I can't even look another cat in the eye since I'm too sick to be doin' crimes properly.
scripts.translation:
[戈比昂吉]
我病得太重，連壞事都做不好，
甚至不敢直視其他貓。

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
I wish I had some peppy bistmuth pills...
Meanwhile the Captain only thinks about catching the bad guys and getting revenge!
...
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
真希望能有幾片提神的鉍片...
船長卻只想著抓壞人、找人報仇！
...

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
How can we follow someone so single-minded!
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
他一根筋成這樣，我們怎麼跟得上啊！

scripts.text:
[Gonanee]
We are the only violent gang in Malangdo and we are very proud.
I don't feel right just lying in bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈納尼]
我們可是綿綿島唯一的暴力幫派，為此很自豪。
光躺在床上什麼也不做，真讓人渾身不自在。

scripts.text:
[Godoree]
I saw unfamiliar cats around
the dock recently.
Are they tourists?
I should -inspect- their pockets
once I'm better...
scripts.translation:
[戈多里]
最近碼頭附近出現了些陌生貓。
是遊客嗎？
等我病好了，一定要-檢查-一下它們的口袋...

scripts.text:
He appears to be listening intently.
Upon hearing you approach, he pretends to be completely oblivious.
scripts.translation:
他似乎正專心偷聽。
聽見你走近，他立刻裝作若無其事。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Oh the pain, oh the pain of it all...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
哎喲，好疼啊...哪兒都疼...

scripts.text:
On listening to the story for
a while, he pretends to be indifferent once hearing someone's noise.
scripts.translation: 他聽了一會兒，聽見有人走近，便裝出一副滿不在乎的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Could it BE any smoggier today?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
今天的霧霾還真重啊？

scripts.text:
[A Foolish Cat]
If you stay here, you
can hear all they're saying.
Don't know exactly what, but
you do hear everything.
Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[一隻笨貓]
你留在這裡的話，
就能聽見他們在說什麼。
雖然不太清楚具體內容，
但什麼都能聽到。
嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: You hear a conversation between the Suspious Dealers.
scripts.translation: 你聽見了幾名可疑商人的談話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Because unexpected robbery at that moment...
our great work has delayed.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
剛才那場意外的搶劫...
耽誤了我們的大計劃。

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Do not worry about the thing, I placed it near balloon bag where
Ship Navi is in the north, and I hid it perfectly.
scripts.translation:
[十分可疑的商人]
別擔心那件東西。我把它藏在了北邊納維號的氣球袋附近，藏得很嚴實。

scripts.text: You need to check a place near north of balloon bag in ship Navi.
scripts.translation: 你得去納維號上氣球袋北邊的附近找找。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你仍聽見可疑的談話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
But near the balloon bag is still
worrying so much!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
可氣球袋附近還是讓人很不放心！

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Oh how cowardly you are!
I hid it in ship Navi perfectly.
Relax!
scripts.translation:
[十分可疑的商人]
你也太膽小了吧！
我已經把東西好好藏在納維號上了。
放心！

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
The rest of part is in staffs.
We should believe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
剩下的部分交給員工了。
我們得相信他們。

scripts.text:
We need to investigate Navi first.
Let's see other guys in ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
我們先調查納維號吧。
去船上看看其他船員。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你仍聽見可疑的談話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Star candy is still healthy,
what happens?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
星星糖還好端端的，
這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
No way...
We should get more bad cans.
scripts.translation:
[十分可疑的商人]
不可能...
我們得再弄些壞罐頭來。

scripts.text: There's a memo.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一張便條。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Here is not what we wanted, huh!
scripts.translation:
[便條]
這裡不是我們要找的地方，對吧！

scripts.text: ...do listen the conversation of merchant.
scripts.translation: ...繼續聽商人們談話。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
We quit selling them, find another merchant!
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
我們不賣這些了，去找別的商人！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
Bad cans?
Due to lots of work in here
can't have a short time to talk?
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
壞罐頭？
這裡忙得很，連跟你說幾句話的空都沒有。

scripts.text: Look suspicious?
scripts.translation: 我看起來很可疑？

scripts.text: I knew all things here!
scripts.translation: 我已經知道這裡所有的事了！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
I have a same boat with you!
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
我跟你是一條船上的！

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
...
You searched the lounge of ship Navi?
...
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
...
你搜查過納維號的休息室了？
...

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
It looks wrong place~
Go and do other things~!
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
你找錯地方了吧~
去做點別的事吧~！

scripts.text: You need to search lounge of ship Navi?
scripts.translation: 你需要搜查納維號的休息室嗎？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
A thought to search Gozangee around ship Navi
is like to ride a skill
with frying pan, it is idiot things.
I do not recommend.
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
想在納維號周圍搜查戈贊吉，就像拿平底鍋施展騎乘技能一樣荒唐。
我可不建議你這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
You searched the lounge of ship Navi?
But still nothing in hand.
I told you there's nothing.
...
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
你搜查過納維號的休息室了？
還是沒找到東西啊。
我不是早就說過那裡什麼都沒有嗎？
...

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
...there must be something...
scripts.translation:
[非常可疑的商人]
...那裡一定藏著什麼...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Rato]
If you were a more professional adventurer, I'd ask you one thing...
Well, I won't do it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
要是你是個更有經驗的冒險者，我倒有件事想請教...
算了，還是不說了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey there.
I am Rato, do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
你好。
我叫拉托，你有空嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, sure I do.
scripts.translation: 當然有空

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在很忙

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Well, nothing special, but could you do me a favor?
Did you see the kids gathered on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
沒什麼大事，不過能請你幫個忙嗎？
你來的路上看到那群孩子了嗎？

scripts.text: Kids?
scripts.translation: 孩子？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes yes, baby kids.
They are the youngest kids among the merchants and crews.
They feel anxious that they might not be able to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是啊，那些小貓。
他們是商人和船員中年紀最小的孩子。
他們擔心自己可能再也回不了家。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
And they are getting bored of living on this small island.
They already tasted sea and adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們也厭倦了在這座小島上生活。
畢竟他們已經見識過大海，也體驗過冒險...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They used to play with making things, but seem tired of that also...
If it's okay, would you play with them for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們以前喜歡自己做些東西玩，不過似乎也玩膩了...
方便的話，你能陪他們玩一會兒嗎？

scripts.text: Uh, sure...
I don't have enough time for that.
scripts.translation: 我沒時間陪他們

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, thank you!
Then, where are they?
Maybe near Beginning Compass...?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，謝謝你！
他們在哪兒呢？
會不會在起始羅盤附近...？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They are so active that I am not sure where they are now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們太活潑了，我也不知道現在跑到哪兒去了。
遇見他們的話，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
It's okay even though you cannot do this right now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是嗎？
你現在沒空也沒關係。
遇見他們的話，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text: If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation: 遇見他們的話，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
Please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的叫查羅，毛是金色的。
羅庫是黑毛，羅西是白毛。
拜託你照看他們了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
I am sorry for disturbing you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是嗎？
抱歉打擾你了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的叫查羅，毛是金色的。
羅庫是黑毛，羅西是白毛。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
We can look forward to the moment we can go back home if these children grow up nicely.
For that reason, please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
只要這些孩子能平安長大，我們就還有回家的希望。
所以，請幫忙照看他們。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Do kids disturb you too much?
What... adventurer group? Did you play with toys from the adventurer group?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
孩子們是不是太纏著你了？
什麼...冒險者團體？你是用他們的玩具陪孩子玩的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I really worried about them the first time we were shipwrecked to this island...
They thought the first voyage was huge adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
剛漂流到這座島上時，我真的很擔心他們...
可他們卻把第一次航海當成了一場大冒險...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They look excited, like they got a fever.
It seems like yesterday that I made toys for them and soothed them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們興奮得像發燒了一樣。
我彷彿昨天才剛做了玩具哄他們開心...

scripts.text: Rato seems to be in brown study.
scripts.translation: 拉托似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text:
You didn't bring the pieces of the painting.
Please take it with you.
scripts.translation:
你還沒帶畫作碎片來。
請把碎片帶來。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
What's going on?
It should be very hard to take care of the kids even though I asked you, isn't it?
I am sorry, I should take care of them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
怎麼了？
雖然是我拜託你的，照顧孩子還是很辛苦吧？
抱歉，我應該自己照看他們...

scripts.text: You hand Rato a piece of painting.
scripts.translation: 你把一塊畫作碎片遞給拉托。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, this is a piece of painting?
Ah!!!
Has this painting been torn up already?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，這是畫作碎片？
啊！！！
這幅畫已經被撕碎了？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Did they say this is a gift for me?
Huhhuh, a piece of painting?
HAHAHAHAHA!
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們說這是送給我的禮物？
呼呼，畫作碎片？
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Okay, I will patch up this painting by myself.
They are still the same.
I think I should worry about myself first...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
好吧，我自己來修補這幅畫。
他們還是老樣子...
我想我還是先擔心自己吧...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
It's very kind of you to play with the kids.
This is for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
謝謝你陪孩子們玩。
這個送給你。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I owe you a big favor!
Let's drink today!
Miaow~
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
我欠你一個大人情！
今天一起喝一杯吧！
喵嗚~

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey, how's it going? If you have time please look at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嗨，最近怎麼樣？有空的話，來看看這個吧。

scripts.text: Look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 看看畫

scripts.text: Don't look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 不看畫

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes, they drew this picture full of happiness.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
沒錯，他們畫下了這幅充滿歡樂的畫。

scripts.text: Appreciate the picture in the frame.
scripts.translation: 欣賞相框裡的畫。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Why don't you look at such a nice picture?
I'm disapointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
這麼好看的畫，你怎麼不看看？
我有點失望。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄太滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
scripts.translation:
有幾隻貓看起來比其他船員年紀小。
他們正認真討論面前那臺奇怪的機器。

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
They look like the kids that Rato told me about.
scripts.translation:
有幾隻貓看起來比其他船員年紀小。
他們正認真討論面前那臺奇怪的機器。
看起來就是拉托提到的那些孩子。

scripts.text: Just watch them without a word.
scripts.translation: 不出聲地看著他們

scripts.text: Busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙

scripts.text: You try to listen to the conversation without disturbing them.
scripts.translation: 你試著不驚動他們，悄悄聽他們說話。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
When will it be fixed? When it will be done?
Isn't this the last one?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
什麼時候才能修好？還要多久？
這應該是最後一個了吧？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um... you don't even get tried of it?
Anyway, we are in trouble.
The glass bead is broken.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯...你們還不膩嗎？
總之，我們遇到麻煩了。
玻璃珠碎了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Don't we have an extra glass bead?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
我們沒有備用的玻璃珠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
No, we don't have any.
We can't fix this without it, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
沒有，一顆都沒有。
沒有它就修不好了，對吧？

scripts.text: The cats look your way at the same time.
scripts.translation: 幾隻貓同時轉頭看向你。

scripts.text: I have a spare Glass Bead!
scripts.translation: 我有備用的玻璃珠！

scripts.text: Why are you guys staring at me?
scripts.translation: 你們為什麼盯著我看？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is no glass bead.
Don't lie to us.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
根本沒有玻璃珠。
別騙我們。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really? Oh, really?
It's a bead! And a shining glass bead as well!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
真的嗎？真的有嗎？
是玻璃珠！而且還閃閃發亮！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hmm. This is enough to replace it.
Like this...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯，這個剛好可以替換。
像這樣...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
And then here, this?
Done.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
然後這裡...這樣？
好了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Exciting!!!
Okay, adventurer! We'll give you the right to use this machine!
Try this whenever you want to!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
太棒了！！！
冒險者，我們授予你使用這臺機器的權利！
以後想玩隨時都可以來！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Advanturer! This is a delicious can.
You can get whatever you want with cans in this island. It is tradable.
Rosy, Roku and I collected them.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
冒險者！這是美味的罐頭。
在島上，罐頭可以換到任何想要的東西，也能和別人交易。
羅西、羅庫和我收集了這些。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
And adventurer!
If you were a real adventurer,
you would clear all Nyadventures
made by the Meow Bravery Team!
Challenge it whenever you want to!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
還有，冒險者！
如果你是真正的冒險者，
就來完成喵之勇氣隊製作的
所有喵冒險吧！
隨時歡迎來挑戰！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We are just looking at you as you stand there.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我們只是看著你站在那裡而已。

scripts.text: I'll come again later.
scripts.translation: 我晚點再來。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We fixed the Duruduru compass, we only need a visitor now...
Hey, do you want to be a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我們修好了嘟嘟羅盤，現在只差一位訪客了...
嘿，你想當這位訪客嗎？

scripts.text: A visitor?
scripts.translation: 訪客？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is an adventure course made by the Meow adventure team.
Especially we have added studying course this time.
It's simple to solve, you only need to find compass in this island according to order.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是喵冒險隊製作的冒險課程。
這次還特別加入了學習課程。
玩法很簡單，只要按順序找到島上的羅盤就行。

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我來試試

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here is your Adventure Card.
This is the Duruduru Compass which we fixed with the glass bead you gave us.
And this is the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是你的冒險卡。
這臺是我們用你給的玻璃珠修好的嘟嘟羅盤。
這臺則是起始羅盤。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you put the Adventure Card in here!
This machine is for testing essential ingredients of adventure.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
把冒險卡放進這裡，遊戲就會開始！
這臺機器會考驗冒險者必備的基本能力。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't forget the destination for successful adventure.
And you should find a way to get to your destination as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
別忘了冒險的終點。
還要想辦法儘快抵達目的地。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You will be good, as you are a good person for giving us the glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你願意把玻璃珠給我們，真是個好人，一定能順利完成的。

scripts.text:
Got Adventure Card from the yellow cat Charo.
It seems to work if I put this card in the slot in the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
我從黃毛貓查羅那裡拿到了冒險卡。
看起來把卡插進起始羅盤的卡槽裡就能啟動。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
在起始羅盤上刷一下冒險卡，遊戲就會開始！
起始羅盤會告訴你該往哪裡走。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
^4d4dff通過所有羅盤後，最後就能看到納維號上的喵鈴！
敲響新鈴鐺吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Ah... you are not going to do it...
Um...
Sob~
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
啊...你不打算參加嗎...
嗯...
嗚...
喵...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hey, adventurer. Don't make kids cry!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
喂，冒險者，別把孩子弄哭了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh? Isn't this failed stamp from Bubi?
I'm really disappointed.
Try again~ you can make it!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
哦？這是布比留下的失敗印章嗎？
我太失望了。
再試一次吧~你一定可以的！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
在起始羅盤上刷一下冒險卡，遊戲就會開始！
起始羅盤會告訴你該往哪裡走。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
^4d4dff通過所有羅盤後，最後就能看到納維號上的喵鈴！
敲響新鈴鐺吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Where is your Adventure Card?
You should bring it with you.
You can't be serious that you threw it away with your other trash!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你的冒險卡呢？
應該隨身帶著才對。
你不會把它和其他垃圾一起扔了吧？！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I heard it!
I heard sound of Meowbell!
You are great!
The next will be a big case!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我聽見了！
我聽見喵鈴響了！
你太厲害了！
接下來可是大案子！

scripts.text: The next?
scripts.translation: 接下來呢？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are member of the Meow Bravery Team while you have the card with you.
We need an adventurer like you anyways, since this is a big case.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
只要帶著這張卡，你就是喵之勇氣隊的成員。
正好有件大案子，我們需要你這樣的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
It's for the cuff.
It seems a bomb is planted in this island.
The detective has went for this case already.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是為了調查案件。
島上好像被人安放了炸彈。
偵探已經去處理這件事了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You should go there too!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你也快去幫忙！

scripts.text: Why do I have to go there?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要去？

scripts.text: What an adventure! I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 真是刺激的冒險！我接了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is a big case!
And this island could explode!
Oh, you might shut your eyes to the fact.
Give the Adventure Card back!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這可是大案子！
整座島都可能爆炸！
你竟然想對這件事視而不見。
把冒險卡還給我！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你很有冒險者的本事！
請幫幫遇到麻煩的偵探和他的朋友，也救救這座島！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
但一定要秘密行動！
所以你得拿上這張證明。
可不能讓偵探把你誤認成敵人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 冒險卡A已更換為冒險卡B。 -

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
那位大偵探和他的朋友就在納維號附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you feel a disposition to help the detective and his friend?
Don't you?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你願意幫偵探和他的朋友嗎？
難道不願意嗎？

scripts.text: Yes I do.
scripts.translation: 願意

scripts.text: No I don't.
scripts.translation: 不願意

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你很有冒險者的本事！
請幫幫遇到麻煩的偵探和他的朋友，也救救這座島！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
但一定要秘密行動！
所以你得拿上這張證明。
可不能讓偵探把你誤認成敵人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 冒險卡A已更換為冒險卡B。 -

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be acound ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
那位大偵探和他的朋友會在納維號附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh my god, the great detective and the ship Navi...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
天哪，那位大偵探和納維號...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
那位大偵探和他的朋友就在納維號附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I have been waiting for you...~
Oh, I am short of breath from coming here in a hurry.
Hmph... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我一直在等你呢...~
啊，我一路趕過來，都喘不過氣了。
呼...喵...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't you have anything to show me?
Let me see it quickly!
Take it out!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你沒帶要給我看的東西嗎？
快讓我看看！
拿出來！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
What? You don't have it?
It can't be true.
Surely you took this with you...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
什麼？你沒帶？
不可能。
你肯定隨身帶著的...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
How come it happened?
This painting is very important for us.
Please give it back to us.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
怎麼會這樣？
這幅畫對我們很重要。
請把它還給我們。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Yes, this is it!
This is our...
But, how do we put the broken pieces together?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
沒錯，就是這塊！
這是我們的...
不過，這些碎片要怎麼拼起來呢？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We need a board and glue as well to put it together.
That's too troublesome to just give it away!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
還得找塊板子和膠水才能拼起來。
送出去也太麻煩了吧！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Rato, looks like he is happy.
He will understand.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
拉托看起來很高興。
他會明白我們的心意。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really...?
There is no Meow team and us without Rato.
I feel a little bad to give only pieces of painting but...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
真的嗎...？
沒有拉托，就沒有喵隊，也沒有我們。
只送畫作碎片過去，我有點過意不去...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We have no other way!
Rato treated this by himself!
No, it's better to ask Rato to put this back together.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
也沒別的辦法了！
拉托會自己處理好的！
不，還是請拉托把畫拼起來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Good idea.
That's really a good idea.
I was getting tired of it.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
好主意。
這主意真不錯。
我都快被這件事煩死了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are a member of the Meow Bravery Team.
Please give these pieces of painting to Rato.
And tell him to treat it preciously as our treasure...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你是喵之勇氣隊的成員。
請把這些畫作碎片交給拉托，
告訴他要像珍寶一樣好好珍藏...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We couldn't make the Bravery Team without Rato.
Please.
Tell him we didn't forget our home island.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
沒有拉托，就沒有喵之勇氣隊。
拜託你了，告訴他我們沒有忘記故鄉的島。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Please give this pating to Rato.
We drawed this painting to show Rato.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
給你！請把這幅畫交給拉托。
我們畫下來就是想給他看的。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here you are! Our emeritus member of the new Bravery Team!
Where did you go for adventure today?
Are these adventure stories?!
If not, then...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
給你！喵之勇氣隊的新任榮譽成員！
今天去了哪裡冒險？
這些是冒險故事嗎？！
要不是的話...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You might have come here for the compass race like huge tuna from our Meow Bravery Team!!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你是來參加嘟嘟羅盤比賽的吧？就像我們喵之勇氣隊那條大金槍魚一樣！！
喵！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Well, Homnya and Nyangson are too difficult for me.
...?
I meant the book is difficult for me.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
嗯，霍姆尼亞和喵森對我來說太難了。
...？
我是說，那本書太難了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you know how much Rato loves the painting which you have found?
He put framed the painting on the wall!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你知道拉托有多喜歡你找到的那幅畫嗎？
他已經把它裝裱起來掛在牆上了！
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I miss my hometown.
But Malangdo is also my hometown as well.
I am okay with us all together in here~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我很想念故鄉。
不過綿綿島也是我的家。
只要大家都在這裡，我就滿足了~

scripts.text:
A young cat with white fur tries so hard with the weird machine.
The machine might be broken.
scripts.translation:
一隻白毛小貓正努力擺弄那臺奇怪的機器。
機器可能壞了。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um? The adventurer who brought us the glass bead?
I really thank you for that.
We could fix the compass with that glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯？你就是給我們帶來玻璃珠的冒險者嗎？
真的很謝謝你。
多虧那顆玻璃珠，我們才修好了羅盤。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Adventure Card? Will you do the Duruduru race?
It's hard to say it's fun even though we made it.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
冒險卡？你要參加嘟嘟羅盤比賽嗎？
雖然是我們設計的，但我也不敢說它有多好玩。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh, it's fun! Perfectly fun!
I have remodeled it this time!!
It will be really fun!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
好玩！絕對好玩！
這次我重新改裝過了！！
一定會特別有趣！！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Yes. It's fun, as Charo said.
Maybe.
...
It is.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
對，就像查羅說的，很好玩。
大概吧。
...
確實很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Meow...
I feel sleepy today.
I've had sore throat these day because I talked too much...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
喵...
我今天好睏。
這幾天說話太多，嗓子都疼了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Don't you agree with me, friend?
...?
Oh, I didn't even realize...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
朋友，你也這麼覺得吧？
...？
哎呀，我剛才沒注意到...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Forget about it!
Doesn't this machine ever break?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
算了！
這臺機器怎麼總是壞？

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄太滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
A young black cat helps the busy white cat.
Maybe the machine is broken.
scripts.translation:
一隻小黑貓正在幫忙碌的白貓。
機器好像壞了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Oh? You are the one who gave us the glass bead.
Thanks a lot.
I am happy, too, because Charo looks happy.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
哦？你就是送我們玻璃珠的人啊。
多謝了。
查羅這麼開心，我也很高興。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes it.
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅喜歡就好。
應該會很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo has been waiting for so long.
To Charo...
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅等了很久了。
給查羅的...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你有話要對我說嗎？

scripts.text: Report results of the race.
scripts.translation: 彙報比賽結果

scripts.text: Challenge the race.
scripts.translation: 挑戰比賽

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Bubi, no confirmation stamps and card.
You will be in trouble if you are like this.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
布比，你的確認印章和卡片都不見了。
這樣下去會惹麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Good job.
You are very smart.
This is a gift for you.
Please come tomorrow again.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
做得好，你很聰明。
這是給你的禮物。
明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes you so much.
He will be happy if you come.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅很喜歡你。
你要是來，他一定會很開心。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Failed...
...is it too difficult for you?
But the race is available only once a day.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
失敗了...
...對你來說太難了嗎？
不過比賽一天只能參加一次。

scripts.text: Give me one more chance!
scripts.translation: 再給我一次機會！

scripts.text: Okay.I will try tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 好吧，明天再試

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Um... Um... Well...
If you bring a Malangdo Can,
I will give you one more chance.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
嗯...嗯...這個嘛...
帶一罐綿綿島罐頭來，我就再給你一次機會。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay. Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好。要用1個綿綿島罐頭換一張冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text: Exchange for Adventure Card A.
scripts.translation: 兌換冒險卡A

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你已經有一張了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
這是你的冒險卡。
起始羅盤，啟動！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have reported the result for today already.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你今天已經彙報過結果了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are too hasty.
You didn't even finish the race.
It's still going.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你太心急了。
比賽還沒結束呢。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
The result is little weird, but...
This is neither a complete race nor incomplete race.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
結果有點奇怪...
說不上完成，也不能算沒完成。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Is this because of the machine?
Let's make void for this race.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
是機器出問題了嗎？
這次比賽就作廢吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have failed?
Do you want to try again?
I will delete the report of the failed result.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你失敗了嗎？
還想再試一次嗎？
我會刪掉這次失敗的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
No, not yet.
Duruduru race is only once for a day.
If we do it more often, the machine will break.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
不，現在還不行。
嘟嘟羅盤比賽一天只能參加一次。
玩得太頻繁，機器會壞掉的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
I know that you will try the Duruduru race.
I deleted your last report.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
我知道你還想參加嘟嘟羅盤比賽。
我已經刪掉你上次的記錄了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You need a Adventure Card to challenge again.
Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
想再次挑戰，得先有冒險卡。
要用1個綿綿島罐頭換一張冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡

scripts.text: Just stop it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你已經有一張了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is nothing for free.
You need a Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
沒有免費的東西。
需要用一個綿綿島罐頭來換。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
這是你的冒險卡。
起始羅盤，啟動！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are the weird one.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你才奇怪呢。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
The kids said this was the ride called Duruduru compass of the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
孩子們說這是喵之勇氣隊的遊樂設施——嘟嘟羅盤。

scripts.text:
An iron pot contains a map of Malangdo with a card inserter.
After inserting your card, a red button and the map inside the pot light up.
It seems to start after pressing the button.
scripts.translation:
鐵鍋裡裝著綿綿島地圖，旁邊有個卡片插槽。
插入卡片後，紅色按鈕和鍋裡的地圖都會亮起來。
看起來按下按鈕就能啟動。

scripts.text: Start it right now.
scripts.translation: 現在啟動

scripts.text: Start it later.
scripts.translation: 稍後啟動

scripts.text: The card has come out with lights on the map after pressing the button.
scripts.translation: 按下按鈕後，卡片彈了出來，地圖上的燈也亮了。

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 遊戲已經開始了！

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 遊戲已經開始了！

scripts.text: Challenge it a little later.
scripts.translation: 請稍後再來挑戰。

scripts.text:
The destination displays with pressing the button after inserting the card.
It's above the deck in the middle of the island!
scripts.translation:
插入卡片並按下按鈕，目的地就會顯示出來。
就在島中央的甲板上！

scripts.text:
Beginning Compass among the Duruduru compass.
The Duruduru race starts from this compass.
scripts.translation:
這是嘟嘟羅盤的起始羅盤。
嘟嘟羅盤比賽從這裡開始。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card and pressing the red button, the path to the destination lit up.
The order will be {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片並按下紅色按鈕後，通往目的地的路線亮了起來。
順序是{0}^000000。

scripts.text: The order will be {0}^000000.

There is a strange machine.
This is the Duruduru compass from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
這是喵之勇氣隊的嘟嘟羅盤。

scripts.text:
Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
After inserting the card and pressing the button, characters appear on the screen.
scripts.translation:
精緻的{0}色燈光環繞著{1}。
插入卡片並按下按鈕後，螢幕上就會出現文字。

scripts.text: Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
scripts.translation: 精緻的{0}色燈光環繞著{1}。

scripts.text: ^00FF00This is a card that didn't start the game yet. Please go back to the Beginning Compass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^00FF00這張卡還沒啟動遊戲，請回到起始羅盤。^000000

scripts.text:
Welcome to the exciting number world!
Enter the exact answer after reading the question!
scripts.translation:
歡迎來到刺激的數字世界！
看清題目後輸入正確答案！

scripts.text:
The card slides out with a sound after entering the number.
^4d4dffYou have passed the {0}! Run to the next destination!^000000
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
輸入數字後，卡片伴著提示音滑了出來。
^4d4dff你通過了{0}！快跑去下一個目的地！^000000
快去下一個目的地吧。

scripts.text:
You've got wrong answer!
You can not pass here without exact answer!
Enter exact answer after read question!
scripts.translation:
答案錯了！
答對才能通過這裡！
看清題目後再輸入正確答案！

scripts.text:
The compass needle turns around in the middle of map.
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
地圖中央的羅盤指標轉動起來。
快跑去下一個目的地吧。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You are going the wrong way! The paths in the card and compass don't line up!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你走錯方向了！卡片上的路線和羅盤不一致！^000000

scripts.text:
There is a fancy bell which doesn't fit in with the ship.
This bell is used in a game by the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
船上有個格格不入的華麗鈴鐺。
這是喵之勇氣隊在遊戲中使用的鈴鐺。

scripts.text:
There is a one more little bell beside the huge notice bell in the deck.
This is the Meowbell from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
甲板上的大型通知鈴旁邊，還有一隻小鈴鐺。
這是喵之勇氣隊的喵鈴。

scripts.text:
This is last bell to ring if you have the card for the game.
Nothing to say for now.
scripts.translation:
持有遊戲卡的話，這是最後一個要敲的鈴鐺。
目前沒有其他提示。

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
Knock Meowbell!!
scripts.translation:
這是喵鈴。
把卡插進中間的插槽。
敲響喵鈴！！

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
-- Beep --
The card has out with a warning sound.
scripts.translation:
這是喵鈴。
把卡插進中間的插槽。
-- 嗶 --
卡片伴著警告聲彈了出來。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, I'm suprised.
You rang the Meowbell in a short time.
I think you have the talent to be an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
哦，真讓人驚訝。
你這麼快就敲響了喵鈴。
我看你很有冒險者的天賦。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
People say...
The purpose of this Duruduru game
is to find and go to a destination quickly and accurately.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
聽說...
嘟嘟羅盤比賽就是要又快又準地找到目的地並趕過去。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Go to Charo with that Adventure Card.
I will give you a confirmation stamp for success.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
拿著冒險卡去找查羅。
我會給你蓋個成功印章。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, you've really gotten used to it.
You succeeded again.
I've put my paw stamp here.
Run to Rato now.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
哦，你越來越熟練了。
又成功了。
我已經在這裡蓋上爪印章。
現在去找拉托吧。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
You didn't ring the Meowbell within time.
Well, it's out of my hands now.
I will give you the fail stamp!!
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
你沒能及時敲響喵鈴。
好吧，我也幫不了你了。
給你蓋個失敗印章！！

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Hey, human adventurer, what are you here for?
Yeah~ this is a beautiful view.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嘿，人類冒險者，你來這裡做什麼？
嗯~這裡風景真好。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Are you one of the people who came here to ring the Meowbell?
I am not a member of the Meow Team, but I can give you the confirmation stamp.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
你是來敲喵鈴的嗎？
我雖然不是喵之隊的成員，但可以給你蓋確認印章。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Um, my work?
Oh, that is only for when I am not on a voyage.
I am free these days.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嗯，我的工作？
那是我不出航時才做的事。
最近我正好有空。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Um? What is the matter?
Hey, here is a suspicious guy.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
嗯？怎麼了？
嘿，那邊有個可疑的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
I can surely tell he is drunk by the smell of liquid.
I am so sad that I can not.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
我當然能憑液體的氣味判斷他是不是喝醉了。
可惜我聞不出來。

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that you have such genius analytical skills!
He is not drunk...
scripts.translation:
[偵探的朋友]
哎呀，你的分析能力可真“高明”，真替你難過！
他根本沒喝醉...

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Drunks always smell of liquid.
But he is not, therefore he is not drunk, friend.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
醉漢身上總有液體味。
他沒有液體味，所以他沒喝醉，朋友。

scripts.text: Then what is your identity?
scripts.translation: 那你到底是什麼身份？

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Well... You are everything except drunk!!!
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
嗯...除了醉鬼，你什麼都像！！！

scripts.text: The voice of the cats sounded shaky.
scripts.translation: 貓的聲音聽起來有些發顫。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
What did I say?
Didn't I tell you that someone will come here soon?
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
我說過什麼來著？
我不是說很快就會有人來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Great.
I can only admire your deduction.
scripts.translation:
[偵探的朋友]
真了不起。
我只能佩服你的推理。

scripts.text:
[Detective Homnya]
Haha, Nyangson, this is nothing for me.
Before that, let's listen to the stories from the visitor first.
scripts.translation:
[偵探霍姆尼亞]
哈哈，喵森，這點小事難不倒我。
先聽聽這位訪客怎麼說吧。

scripts.text: Charo? Rosy?
scripts.translation: 查羅？羅西？

scripts.text: Are you guys detectives?
scripts.translation: 你們是偵探嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
No... Who are they?
Nyangson, do you know them?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
不是...他們是誰？
喵森，你認識他們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I... I don't know either?
I don't know Charo and Rosy!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我...我也不認識啊？
我不認識查羅和羅西！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes. Yes.
We are the detective and friend!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒錯，沒錯。
我們是偵探和他的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I am the detective, Homnya.
And this is my friend, Nyangson. He reports my cases.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
對，我是偵探霍姆尼亞。
這位是我的朋友喵森，負責報道我的案件。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Anyways, that's not important for now!
We should focus on current situation.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
總之，現在先不說這個！
我們得專心處理眼前的情況。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, that's right, friend.
We think........
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是啊，沒錯，朋友。
我們覺得...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes! This is a bomb for sure!
I am so sorry, I have only analytical and detective skills but don't have the skill to dispose of a bomb!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒錯！這肯定是炸彈！
真抱歉，我只會分析和辦案，不會拆炸彈！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
What do you mean by that?
It doesn't make any sense!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你這話是什麼意思？
根本說不通啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, we shout when it changed from the peak of hope into the peak of sorrow.
Peak!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒錯！從希望的頂點跌到絕望的深淵時，我們就該大喊：
頂點！
喵！

scripts.text: I don't get the meaning of this, but they seem to be in hurry.
scripts.translation: 我聽不懂他們在說什麼，不過他們似乎很著急。

scripts.text: Continue to humor them.
scripts.translation: 繼續陪他們演下去

scripts.text: Stop playing around.
scripts.translation: 別再胡鬧了

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, if you give us a hand, I will take it. How do you think about it, friend?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，你肯幫忙的話，我當然接受。你覺得呢，朋友？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I don't really care about it. What I want to do is only to report this case.
One of the cases will be open to the public among the most strange and weird cases ever.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我倒不怎麼在意。我只想把這起案件報道出來。
這會成為史上最離奇案件之一，公之於眾。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew this visitor had the skill to dispose of a bomb.
He is totally prepared to escape from danger.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我就知道這位訪客會拆炸彈。
他顯然做好了應對危險的準備。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, I heard of it. I heard they use fly wings and butterfly wings as well.
I've never thought I could meet a person who used these thing for real.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，我聽說過。聽說他們會用蒼蠅翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
沒想到我真能遇到使用這些東西的人。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I believe this visitor will solve our mystery.
Then please stop this damn machine!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我相信這位訪客能解開謎團。
那麼，請把這臺該死的機器停下來！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, the damn machine!
It is loud and useless!
And it will be blown up.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯，就是這臺該死的機器！
又吵又沒用！
還會被炸飛！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well, stop this machine!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
好了，快把機器停下來！！！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please don't...
Please act according to the script.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
別這樣...
照著劇本演就好。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Charo. Where is the script?
No, Homnya. My friend...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
查羅，劇本呢？
不，霍姆尼亞，我的朋友...

scripts.text: Two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓緊張得滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
This is the moment that your memory can be coming through!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
把這臺吵死人的機器停下來！
你的記憶就要浮現了！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes. Yes.
This is the sort of training where you dispose of and breach all the traps.
Yes, this is.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯，沒錯。
這就是拆除並突破所有陷阱的訓練。
就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It was a scary moment.
This machine is still fine anyways!
Stop it again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
剛才真是嚇人。
不過機器還好好的！
再把它停下來。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, you need Adventure Card B to operate this machine.
Do you want to buy a new one?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
對，要操作這臺機器，需要冒險卡B。
要買一張新的卡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It costs one Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
需要一個綿綿島罐頭。

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡

scripts.text: Do not buy.
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I said I can exchange Adventure Card with one Malango Can~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我說過可以用一個綿綿島罐頭換冒險卡~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
See, this is a scary machine.
Here is your Adventure Card.
Stop this machine this time.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
看，這機器挺嚇人的吧。
這是你的冒險卡。
這次把機器停下來。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
What?
But you came here to buy a Adventure Card.
......
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
什麼？
你不是來買冒險卡的嗎？
...

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
If you buy a Adventure Card there won't be any bloodshed...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
買了冒險卡，就不會有人受傷了...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，有個好訊息告訴你。
你剛才跟機器搏鬥時，我收到一個好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能幹的朋友，有什麼發現？
是隱藏的寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
寶藏？很像！
它們藏在納維號船艙裡的好幾個地方。
快去找找！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我有點累了

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 哦，好啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，是嗎？累了就先休息吧。
想繼續的話，隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
有空再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我就知道你會答應！
我看人的眼光很準。
地點就在納維號的船艙裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
地方不大，不用擔心。
期待你大顯身手！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please find the pieces of the treasure.
The treasure is hidden inside of the ship Navi according to our information.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請找出寶藏碎片。
根據我們的情報，它們藏在納維號船艙裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Come here right after you find treasure!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
找到寶藏後馬上回來！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You've found all the treasure.
Yes, exactly.
You might thought this painting was just a normal painting.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
你把所有寶藏都找齊了。
沒錯，就是這些。
你可能以為這只是一幅普通的畫。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
But...!
If we do this...!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
但是...！
只要我們這樣做...！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, this is....... the one from that moment...
This is the one when we left our hometown.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，這是...那時候的...
這是我們離開故鄉時的畫面。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's time to give it back to the brave new team!
Let's give it back!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
該把畫還給喵之勇氣隊了！
還給大家吧！
喵~

scripts.text:
Charo and Rosy who make up as Homnya and Nyangson
checked the pieces of painting and give it back again.
They look excited.
scripts.translation:
查羅和羅西扮成霍姆尼亞與喵森，檢查了畫作碎片後又把它們拼了起來。
他們看起來很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give it back to the Meow Bravery Team~
For everyone~ Meow~
These are real treasures!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請把它還給喵之勇氣隊~
為了大家~喵~
這些才是真正的寶藏！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well? It's strange. There should be 6 pieces of treasure.
It's missing pieces...
Is this fake? I will throw it out!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嗯？真奇怪，寶藏應該有六塊。
怎麼少了幾塊...
這是假的吧？我要把它扔掉！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go get the treasure again!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
再去把寶藏找回來！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give these treasures you've found to the Meow Bravery Team.
You will know how precious these treasures are when you give these to them~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請把找到的寶藏交給喵之勇氣隊。
交給他們之後，你就會明白這些寶藏有多珍貴~

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, you will realize.
It's good to take a break for little bit but now we don't have any spare time.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯，到時你就會明白。
稍微歇會兒也好，不過現在可沒時間了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
Insert your Adventure Card, and take a look at the reaction of the machine carefully. Then do the proper action!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
先把這臺吵鬧的機器停下來！
插入冒險卡，仔細觀察機器的反應，再採取相應的行動！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
That's right~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey Nyangson.
Here comes the hero.
He seems to be here for fixing this naughty machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，喵森。
英雄來了。
他好像是來修理這臺調皮機器的。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I always admire your keen insight.
He looks like that for sure.
Then he will buy Adventure Card with Malangdo Can?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我一直很佩服你敏銳的洞察力。
他看起來確實像是來修機器的。
那他會用綿綿島罐頭買冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You are getting better
I always keep eyes on your keen insight.
You are my true friend.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
你越來越厲害了。
我一直在留意你敏銳的洞察力。
你是我真正的朋友。

scripts.text: How's the condition of Bang?
scripts.translation: 邦那邊怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 不理它

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
it's so motivated but it's not the time yet.
Not yet even though naughty machine is noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
它已經躍躍欲試了，不過還沒到時候。
機器再吵也不行，現在還不是時候。
過會兒再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time.....
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我們也要休息的...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Can you hear how noisy this one is?
It sounds like a runaway foal!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
聽聽它有多吵！
簡直像匹脫韁的小馬！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
He needs an Adventure Card to stop it.
Well, do you want to try?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
要用冒險卡才能讓它停下來。
你想試試嗎？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card B.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡B

scripts.text: Don't buy it.
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
How many Malangdo Cans for an Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
一張冒險卡要幾個綿綿島罐頭？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Only one can, dear.
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
只要一個，親愛的。
喵~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, please try it without blowing it up.
Solve it fast!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
好，試試吧，別把它弄炸了。
快點解決！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please do it.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
啊...喂...你不能這樣！
喂，別走！
喵森，快讓它停下來！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
這臺和那臺都吵死了！
拜託了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓緊張得滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
啊...喂...你不能這樣！
喂，別走！
喵森，快讓它停下來！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
這臺和那臺都吵死了！
拜託了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓緊張得滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I am a friend of Detective Homnya, Nyangson.
Please ask Homnya if you have questions.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我是偵探霍姆尼亞的朋友喵森。
有問題就問霍姆尼亞吧。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, he only goes 'yes, my friend' beside me!
Ask me!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒錯，他待在我身邊就只會說“是的，我的朋友”！
問我吧！

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
機身亮著紅、藍、黃、綠四種顏色，旁邊有響應按鈕；它一邊旋轉，一邊發出刺耳的噪音。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它轉得越快，看起來就越不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's so motivated, but it's not time yet.
Not yet, even though the machine is so noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
它已經躍躍欲試了，不過還沒到時候。
機器再吵也不行，現在還不是時候。
過會兒再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我們也要休息的...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You can't try this without Adventure Card B.
Please bring it with you.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒有冒險卡B就不能玩這個。
記得帶上卡再來。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
機身亮著紅、藍、黃、綠四種顏色，旁邊有響應按鈕；它一邊旋轉，一邊發出刺耳的噪音。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它轉得越快，看起來就越不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this machine by inserting the card into it!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
把卡插進機器裡，讓它停下來！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go ahead!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
開始吧！

scripts.text: Insert card.
scripts.translation: 插入卡片

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 讓它停下

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Um? You aren't going to do this?
Really?
Even though this machine can blow up the whole island?!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嗯？你不打算試試嗎？
真的嗎？
這臺機器可是能把整座島炸飛的啊？！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Does he know it's never going to blow up?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
他知道這東西根本不會爆炸嗎？

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓緊張得滿頭大汗。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card, discs on top of the machine spin faster...
The lights begin to flicker faster too.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片後，機器頂部的圓盤轉得更快了...
燈光也閃爍得越來越快。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, great!
The banging has stopped!
You have a good memory!
Please take this small gift.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
太好了！
噪音停了！
你的記憶力真好！
請收下這份小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
You can get it after you have been through all the difficulties from the Meow Advanture Team.
And we are not sure if this machine will try to blow up agian, so please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
通過喵冒險隊設定的所有難關後，你就能拿到獎勵。
這臺機器明天還會不會想炸掉自己，我們也不確定...明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，有個好訊息告訴你。
你剛才和機器較勁的時候，我收到了好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能幹的朋友，有什麼發現？
是隱藏的寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
寶藏？差不多！
有些東西藏在船艙裡的幾個地方。
快去找找！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我有點累了

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，是嗎？累了就先休息吧。
想繼續的話，隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
有空再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我就知道你會答應！
我看人的眼光很準。
東西就在納維號的船艙裡。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
地方不大，不用擔心。
期待你大顯身手！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Then I am looking forward to tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
那我就等你明天來！

scripts.text:
Luminous
The order of buttons are:
[Red] [Green] [Blue] [Yellow]
And below this, more buttons:
[Green] [Red] [Yellow] [Blue]
In that order.
scripts.translation:
發光
按鈕亮起的順序是：
[紅] [綠] [藍] [黃]
接下來下面的按鈕會亮起：
[綠] [紅] [黃] [藍]
按這個順序操作。

scripts.text:
Luminous
{0}
Shines according to this order.
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
{0}
燈光會按照這個順序閃爍。
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時限內按下正確的按鈕，停止機器。

scripts.text:
Luminous
{0}
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
{0}
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時限內按下正確的按鈕，停止機器。

scripts.text:
Luminous
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時限內按下正確的按鈕，停止機器。

scripts.text: Which color button do you want to press {0}?
scripts.translation: 你要按下哪個顏色的按鈕？{0}

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黃

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 綠

scripts.text:
The speed of spinning is getting faster after pressing the buttons.
After all...
scripts.translation:
按下按鈕後，圓盤轉得越來越快。
最後...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Watch out!!!
 
[Nyangson]
It's blowing up!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
小心！！！

[喵森]
它要爆炸了！

scripts.text:
Adventure Card B burned off
with a huge explosion.
scripts.translation:
冒險卡B
在劇烈爆炸中燒燬了。

scripts.text:
The speed of the spinning discs gets slower after pressing the buttons.
The luminous shines once and stops also.
scripts.translation:
按下按鈕後，圓盤轉得慢了下來。
燈光閃了一次，也停了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Don't reduce your tension!
It's not over yet!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
別放鬆警惕！
還沒結束！

scripts.text:
The machine starts again.
And the luminous shines also, as if it keeps asking you for the right answer.
scripts.translation:
機器又啟動了。
指示燈也亮了起來，彷彿在催你給出正確答案。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄太滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
{0}
You found a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你找到了一塊畫作碎片。

scripts.text:
It looks like you can put these pieces of paintings together.
If I found all the pieces, I should go back to Homnya.
scripts.translation:
這些畫作碎片似乎能拼在一起。
找齊之後，應該回去找霍姆尼亞。

scripts.text:
I think this is the treasure Homnya and Nyangson mentioned.
Let's find more pieces.
scripts.translation:
我想這就是霍姆尼亞和喵森提到的寶藏。
再去找些碎片吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you doing here?!
Don't touch that box any more!
There will be more bugs if you keep hiding snacks in there!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
你在這裡做什麼？！
別再碰那個箱子了！
你要是繼續把零食藏在裡面，蟲子只會越來越多！
出去！

scripts.text: A box in the corner of the cabin.
scripts.translation: 船艙角落裡有一個箱子。

scripts.text: This is a box which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 這是一個曾經裝著畫作碎片的箱子。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Ah, do not touch it!
Why do you keep messing it up after I clean up the room?!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
啊，別碰！
我剛收拾好房間，你怎麼又把它弄亂了？！
出去！

scripts.text: The books are organized according to order on the bookshelf.
scripts.translation: 書架上的書按順序擺放著。

scripts.text: This is a book which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 這是一本曾經藏著一塊畫作碎片的書。

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
What are you doing here?
Do not disturb me, and go away.
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
你在這裡幹什麼？
別打擾我，走開。
出去！

scripts.text:
It's dirty and smells like fish.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
又髒又有股魚腥味。
上面沾了不少貓毛。

scripts.text:
This is dirty bed where a piece of the painting was hidden.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
這張床髒兮兮的，曾經藏著一塊畫作碎片。
上面沾了不少貓毛。

scripts.text: There is a seashell decoration on a clean display cupboard.
scripts.translation: 乾淨的陳列櫃上擺著一個貝殼裝飾。

scripts.text: This is the seashell where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 這個貝殼曾經藏著一塊畫作碎片。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Is that you who scratched all the pillars in here?!
Meow~~~~!!
Get off from that pillar!
scripts.translation:
[挑剔的船員]
是你把這裡所有的柱子都抓花了嗎？！
喵~~~~！！
快從柱子上下來！

scripts.text:
I can see the trace of a scratch.
Pillars made from trees are originally good to hang, but scratched by nails.
scripts.translation:
上面能看到抓痕。
樹木製成的柱子本來很適合攀爬，卻被爪子抓花了。

scripts.text: I can see the crack where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 我能看到那道藏過畫作碎片的裂縫。

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A cold wind comes from these windows.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上開著幾扇通風窗。
冷風正從窗戶裡灌進來。
為什麼要把通風窗開在地板上？

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A piece of the painting was hung in there.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上開著幾扇通風窗。
裡面曾掛著一塊畫作碎片。
為什麼要把通風窗開在地板上？

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Please clean up your stuff by yourself.
Especially you guys getting dirty after we came to this island!
Please throw the trash into the trash can.
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
自己的東西請自己收拾好。
尤其是你們，來這座島之後把周圍弄得髒兮兮的！
垃圾請扔進垃圾桶。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
And you plucked every crop.
Hmph. Please, let's leave it in its natural state.
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
你們還把莊稼都摘光了。
哼，拜託了，讓它們自然生長吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you looking at?
Will you mess up here too?
Meow?!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
你在看什麼？
也打算在這裡搗亂嗎？
喵？！

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
I try to be nice these days, and kids just take liberties with me.
Will you too?
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
我最近才試著和善一點，小鬼們就開始蹬鼻子上臉。
你也想這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
They just come in and out, even the other person's room...
It causes harm for sure.
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
他們進進出出，連別人的房間也照闖不誤……
這肯定會惹出麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Do not run in the hall!
My fur falls out because of someone who
scratches everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[挑剔的船員]
別在走廊裡跑！
不知道是誰到處亂抓，害得我掉了一地毛！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一隻看起來溫和的貓正在低聲自語。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello... Mr. Cat...
The cat takes a glance at you and goes back to his whispering as if he didn't even see you.
scripts.translation: 那隻貓瞥了你一眼，隨後像是沒看見你似的，繼續低聲自語。

scripts.text: It seems you are not being considered worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 看來他並不打算理你。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一隻看起來溫和的貓正在低聲自語。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Man! 10 losses in a row...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
天啊……已經連輸十場了……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We are the 'Cat Gamers' Association.
But, we still keep on losing and we have no idea why!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我們是“貓玩家”協會。
可我們一直輸，完全不知道原因！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We've got to find out the reason for this losing streak.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我們得查清楚連敗的原因。

scripts.text: You are getting interested in the cat's story. Let's hear more.
scripts.translation: 你對這隻貓講的事有些好奇，決定繼續聽下去。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The reason, yes!
This can be one of them.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
原因，對！
這可能就是其中一個原因。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
^DD2234Giving up so many points!^000000
That's right. No matter how much you score,
we will still lose if we give up so many points.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
^DD2234丟了這麼多分！^000000
沒錯。無論得多少分，
丟掉這麼多分的話，我們還是會輸。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
For the other reason. Hmm!
This could be related with the previous reason.
No ^DD2234aggresive point betting^000000 at all.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
至於另一個原因……嗯！
這或許和剛才說的原因有關。
完全沒有^DD2234積極下注^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Other teams bet on games that they think will win, and bet low when they are not confident.
I guess we didn't know that.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
其他隊伍會給看好的比賽下重注，沒把握時就少下注。
看來我們之前沒意識到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hmm, can this be a reason?
For some reason there were ^DD2234players disappearing right before the match up^000000 and I guess this could have effected our game spirit.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嗯，這也可能是原因嗎？
不知為何，^DD2234有些選手總在比賽開始前消失^000000，我猜這可能打擊了大家計程車氣。

[貓玩家協會負責人]
嗯……看來我們連敗的原因是：
丟分太多；
下注太保守；
還有選手消失？

scripts.text: It seems like the gentle looking cat has finished thinking. Let's interrupt the conversion.
scripts.translation: 那隻看起來溫和的貓似乎已經想完了。我們打斷這場談話吧。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now that I know the reason,
there should be a solution to that.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
既然知道了原因，
就一定有辦法解決。

scripts.text: Umm... Mr. Cat...
scripts.translation: 那個……貓先生……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Who's there? Human? You are a human?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
誰在那裡？人類？你是人類？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
... ... ... ...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh! Yes! Right!
I remember hearing that
humans have started passing through here recently.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哦！對！沒錯！
我記得最近聽說，
人類開始經過這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So good to see you!!
What is your name by the way?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
見到你真高興！！
對了，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}, Mr. Cat.

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000。
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually I wanted to help you out since I heard that you've lost 10 games in a row...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我聽說你們已經連輸十場了，所以想來幫幫你們……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, you didn't really have to point it out like that...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哎呀，你也不必說得這麼直白吧……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A weakness is no longer a weakness when you say it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
弱點只要說出口，就不再是弱點了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hahahaha I like that phrase.
I should remember it and
tell it to my kids. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哈哈哈，我喜歡這句話。
我得記下來，
講給孩子們聽。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I like you, {0} {1}. Will you help us get out of this 10 game losing streak? Ehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我挺喜歡你的，{0} {1}。能幫我們結束十連敗嗎？嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm a stupid {0}.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我是個愚蠢的{0}。

scripts.text: Sure, I'm a cool {0}.
scripts.translation: 當然，我是個很酷的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Guess I was wrong about you~
How can a person call themself stupid.
Now I can see how stupid you are.
Good bye~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
看來是我看錯你了～
哪有人會說自己很蠢呢？
現在我知道你有多蠢了。
再見～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Wow. I respect you, {0}.
Let me ask you a favor.
Please meet the hard working Manager Cat and ask about our team's attitude these days.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哇，我很佩服你，{0}。
能拜託你一件事嗎？
請去找那位勤勉的貓管理員，問問我們隊最近的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
貓管理員應該就在這附近～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please meet the hard working
Manager Cat, and ask about our team's attitude these days.
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請去找那位勤勉的貓管理員，
問問我們隊最近的狀態。
他應該就在這附近～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok Ok. So what did the manager cat say about the atmosphere these days?~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
好，好。那麼貓管理員怎麼說？最近隊裡的氣氛怎麼樣？～

scripts.text: You tell him exactly what the Manager Cat said.
scripts.translation: 你把貓管理員的話一字不漏地轉告給他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The manager cat said...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
貓管理員說……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Do not hesitate... Just tell me everything~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
別猶豫……全都告訴我吧～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... the player cats are afraid of you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃……那些貓玩家都很怕你……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What... What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
什……你說什麼？

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人似乎大受打擊。讓他先冷靜一會兒吧。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人似乎大受打擊。讓他先冷靜一會兒吧。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
That is impossible!
There is no other cat that's nicer than I am!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
這不可能！
沒有比我更和善的貓了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Am I really that scary?
Are those players who bailed on the practice afraid of me too?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我真的有那麼可怕嗎？
那些缺席訓練的選手，也是因為怕我才不來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
It can't be, right? ehehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
不會吧？嘿嘿嘿嘿～

scripts.text: - He laughs nervously. -
scripts.translation: - 他緊張地笑了起來。 -

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Is that the truth?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
這是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}, will you help me out?
There are 4 players who ran away from practice saying they were too tired.
Could you check if they ran away because of me? ehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
{0}，你能幫幫我嗎？
有四名選手說自己太累了，便從訓練中跑掉了。
你能幫我查查他們是不是因為我才逃走的嗎？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
他們叫埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫。
他們應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請把他們都找出來～
不過別問得太直接！好嗎？
溫和地問問就好～
知道了嗎？一定要！溫柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
多謝你幫忙，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It seems some humans are scamming cats around this town.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～看來有些人類在鎮上欺騙貓咪。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What good is it to scam innocent cats?~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
欺騙無辜的貓咪能有什麼好處呢？～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I think that you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，我也覺得你說得對。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, so you met Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
It is so good to see you again. Heh~
Thank you very much for your effort~. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
哦，原來你見過埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫了。
很高興再次見到你。嘿嘿～
辛苦你了，非常感謝～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So what did they say?
They really think I am scary?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
那他們怎麼說？
他們真的覺得我很可怕嗎？

scripts.text: You tell the Cat Gamers Director what Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff said.
scripts.translation: 你把埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫的話轉告給貓玩家協會負責人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They think you push them too much through the practices. So they are scared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們覺得你訓練時逼得太緊，所以很怕你。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What? Really?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
什麼？真的嗎？

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director seems to be shocked once again. Better give him more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人似乎又受到了打擊。最好再給他一些時間冷靜。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
他們叫埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫。
他們應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請把他們都找出來～
不過別問得太直接！好嗎？
溫和地問問就好～
知道了嗎？一定要！溫柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
多謝你幫忙，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock once again. Better give more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人似乎又受到了打擊。最好多給他一些時間冷靜。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok, I understand.
I was a scary cat after all.
This can't be right!! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
好吧，我明白了。
看來我確實是只可怕的貓。
不對吧！！嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I need to change my scary cat image. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我得改變大家對我這隻可怕貓的印象。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is my mission now,
so our team can improve
game performance. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
這是我現在的使命，
這樣才能提升我們隊伍的
比賽表現。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please go meet our manager cat,
and find out how can I change
this scary cat image of mine. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請去找我們的貓管理員，
問問我該怎麼改變
大家對我這隻可怕貓的印象。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I would much appreciate your help, {0}~.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～要是你能幫忙，{0}，我就太感激了～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please ask our manager cat how can I change this scary cat image.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請去問問我們的貓管理員，我該怎麼改變大家對我這隻可怕貓的印象。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please help me out,
{0}! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～拜託你幫幫我，
{0}！嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
You came back!! Heh~
So, what did our manager cat say?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
你回來了！！嘿嘿～
那麼，我們的貓管理員怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Manager cat asked to prepare a box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
貓管理員讓我準備一個箱子。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
A box? Heh~ Sure, why not?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
箱子？嘿嘿～行啊，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you going to ask me what is it for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不問問箱子是做什麼用的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, I kind of was eavesdropping when {0} and Manager Cat were talking together. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
剛才{0}和貓管理員說話時，我有點在偷聽。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now I need to check with our players, see how they really feel.
Heh~ Why don't you come back tomorrow?
Heh~ Let me decide what to do after checking their honest petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
現在我得問問隊員們，聽聽他們真正的想法。
嘿嘿～你明天再來吧？
等我看完大家真心寫下的請願信，再決定下一步怎麼做。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Still receiving petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
請願信還在陸續送來。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I wonder what they really want to say~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
真想知道他們到底想說什麼～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ All done with collecting petition letters~
Heh~ Let's see what they wrote here?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～請願信都收齊了～
來看看他們寫了什麼吧？嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let me see... 'Stupid Cat lea...de...'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我看看……“笨貓隊長……”

scripts.text:
- Crumpling the paper -
Cat Gamers Director has crumpled the paper and thrown it away.
scripts.translation:
- 把紙揉成一團 -
貓玩家協會負責人把紙揉成一團，扔到了一邊。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wrong paper.
Let's read another one... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～拿錯了。
再讀一封吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ～閱讀中～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here we go.
'I don't like playing with the same team members over and over.
Please pick new team members,
or get me a practicing partner.'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～找到了。
“我不喜歡總是和同一批隊員一起玩。
請換些新隊員，
或者給我找個練習搭檔。”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
I can take this positively.
Heh~ Let's move on to another one.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我知道了。
這意見倒是挺積極的。
嘿嘿～再看下一封吧。

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ～閱讀中～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'We need more snacks~ Get us some more snacks~'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～
“我們還想要更多零食～再給我們一些零食吧～”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This one also sounds productive.
Heh~ Petition letters are good, I guess... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～這封也挺有建設性。
看來請願信確實有用……嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'Elders are bullying me. Help me...'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～
“長老們在欺負我。救救我……”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team is absolutely
like a family here~ Someone is
playing here, you know. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～看來我們隊真的像一家人一樣呢～畢竟隊裡也有人在玩惡作劇嘛。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There are only 4 letters!
Including a prank one...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～一共只有四封信！
其中還有一封是惡作劇……
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Everyone seems to have a satisfied team life~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
看來大家對隊裡的生活都挺滿意嘛～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not... Really...
There are tons of letters piled in the back of the box, but Cat Gamers Director doesn't want to admit the problem.
scripts.translation: 箱子後面還堆著一大摞信，但貓玩家協會負責人不願承認有問題。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Hey, {0}. What did you say? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～
喂，{0}。你剛才說什麼？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing! Please carry on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼！您繼續。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
