Heh~ Because of what these players want,
I have a favor to ask you, {0}...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～隊員們有這些要求，我想請你幫個忙，{0}……
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is it?

[Cat Gamers Director]
Will you be our players' practicing partner?
Heh~ I feel strongly that you, {0}, can be trusted for this. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
你願意做我們隊員的練習搭檔嗎？
嘿嘿～我覺得你，{0}，很值得信賴。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: No thanks, buddy!
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝你，老兄！

scripts.text: Ok, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 好啊，我來幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Are you rejecting me? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～你這是拒絕我嗎？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I'm sad. Sad~ Heh~
I didn't expect a refusal from a person like you, {0}.
But still, here's some coins for you~
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
我好傷心，好傷心～嘿嘿～
沒想到像你這樣的人也會拒絕我，{0}。
不過還是給你些金幣吧～
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We will always welcome you, {0}, as a guest member of the Cat Gamers.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
{0}，我們永遠歡迎你成為“貓玩家”的客座成員。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～改主意的話，隨時歡迎你回來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Good choice.
I knew you would help us Cat Gamers... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～選得好。
我就知道你會幫我們貓玩家……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thank you for your help.
Heh~ Here are some coins as a small gift... Heh~
Get yourself some goodies. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～多謝你幫忙。
嘿嘿～這些金幣是送你的小禮物……嘿嘿～
去買些好吃的吧。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Since you will be our team's practicing partner, please come back in an hour.
Then I will give you our '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
既然你要當我們隊的練習搭檔，一小時後再來一趟。
到時我會把“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”交給你。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ok, {0}. I will see you in an hour. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～好的，{0}。一小時後見。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Aren't you {0}?
Have you changed your mind yet?
Are you willing to be our team's practicing partner?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～
你是{0}吧？
改變主意了嗎？
願意當我們隊的練習搭檔嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing through.
scripts.translation: 不了，我只是路過。

scripts.text: I accept your offer.
scripts.translation: 我接受你的邀請。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
But, let me tell you once again, {0}.
You are always welcome to be one of our 'Cat Gamers Honorable Members'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我知道了。
不過，{0}，我再說一次：
我們隨時歡迎你成為“貓玩家”的榮譽成員。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ At last!!
{0} will become our honorable member!!
I shall make a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' right away. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～終於等到了！！
{0}要成為我們的榮譽成員了！！
我馬上就去做一張“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Come back in an hour and I will get you a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
一小時後再來，我會把“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”給你。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ You want to get the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' faster. Heh~ It's not really easy to get such a certificate easily.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～你想早點拿到“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”吧。嘿嘿～這種證書可沒那麼容易弄到。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So, it's a bit tricky... Heh~ Please come later. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
所以有點棘手……嘿嘿～請稍後再來。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I got a message from the workshop that their work on the certificate is done. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～工坊剛剛傳來訊息，證書已經做好了。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not some ordinary certificate. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
這可不是普通的證書。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This is...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～這可是……

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director's eyes are shining with pride.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人的眼中閃爍著自豪的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The pure essence of the 'Cat Gamers' tech team's effort!!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～這是“貓玩家”技術團隊心血的結晶！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Equip this item, then all of your game playing records will be saved. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～裝備這件物品後，你的所有遊戲記錄都會儲存下來。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Take this and show us what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～拿著它，讓我們見識一下你的本事吧。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I may be worrying too much... But, please wear this '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000', and play the game. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～也許是我太擔心了……不過還是請戴上這張“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”，繼續比賽吧。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello, {0}. How is it going practicing with the players?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～你好，{0}。和隊員們練習得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: How are the players doing?
scripts.translation: 隊員們練得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Just stopped by to say hi~
scripts.translation: 只是順路來打個招呼～

scripts.text: Here's the current status...
scripts.translation: 彙報一下目前的情況……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wow, {0}! I'm so touched by your care for the players.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～哇，{0}！你這麼關心隊員，真讓我感動。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ For 13 years of my life, I've never seen anyone like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我活了十三年，從沒見過像你這樣的人，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ {0}, which player's condition are you interested in?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～{0}，你想了解哪組隊員的情況？

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors players
scripts.translation: 石頭剪刀布組

scripts.text: ChamChamCham players
scripts.translation: 猜猜看組

scripts.text: KongNyangKong players
scripts.translation: 碰碰撞組

scripts.text: Flag Game players
scripts.translation: 奪旗組

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Rock Paper Scissors players are missing practices occasionally, but they are still getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～石頭剪刀布組偶爾會缺席訓練，不過實力還是在進步。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
ChamChamCham players are actually complaining about the practice because you are doing so well with them, very hard to remember the winner. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～猜猜看組的隊員都在抱怨訓練呢，因為你表現太好，他們很難記住誰贏了。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ KongNyangKong players are so happy with the practice. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～碰碰撞組的隊員很喜歡和你訓練。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Flag Game players are always nervous since you make them work so much. Heh~ But, they are really getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～奪旗組的隊員總是很緊張，因為你讓他們練得太辛苦了。嘿嘿～不過他們確實進步很大。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please keep up the good work, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～繼續加油，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello there~ {0}. You have such good manners~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～你好呀，{0}。你真有禮貌～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ These days, there are so many cats and humans without proper manners. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～最近有不少貓和人都不懂基本禮貌。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We also have some of thme in our 'Cat Gamers'. They are so arrogant every time we win the game... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
“貓玩家”協會裡也有這種人。每次贏了比賽，他們就得意忘形……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There should be more people like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～{0}，要是大家都像你這麼有禮貌就好了。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please practice with our players more often~ Heh~ So they can learn some manners from you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～多和我們的隊員練練吧～嘿嘿～他們也能跟你學學禮貌，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Keep up the good work~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
繼續加油～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ What happened to your face, {0}? Guess you lost from the practice, right? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～{0}，你的臉怎麼了？看來訓練時輸掉了吧？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I saw players puting notes in the 'Petition box'. Heh~ Guess that was your work. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我看到隊員們往“請願箱”裡塞紙條了。嘿嘿～看來是你安排的吧。讓我看看……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It's not like I didn't feed them right... Heh~ I hope it was not too much for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～我也沒虧待他們啊……嘿嘿～希望沒讓你太辛苦，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm, 50 Marses, and 30 Milk Bottles... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～嗯，50只烏賊和30瓶牛奶……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team must have some grudge over Team 'Dog n Waltz', enough to ask you for this kind of favor...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～看來我們隊和“狗與華爾茲”隊結了怨，居然讓你幫忙做這種事……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ah, quickness training. It's good to see our players trying their best on training.
Heh~ Yes, nothing is better than mouse catching for improving quickness.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～原來是敏捷訓練。看到隊員們這麼努力訓練真好。
嘿嘿～沒錯，要提升敏捷，抓老鼠最合適了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ '50 Peco Peco please!! Let's party.' Hmm... Heh~ 50 Pecos can feed all of our neighbors.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～“請給我們50只大嘴鳥！！我們要開派對。”嗯……嘿嘿～50只大嘴鳥夠餵飽附近所有鄰居了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm... let me see... Heh~ That's right, I was worrying about our team getting so nervous before the actual game... But, they won't even talk to me about it.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～嗯……我看看……嘿嘿～對了，我一直擔心隊員們正式比賽前太緊張……可他們連這件事都不願意跟我說。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The note says, get me 30 Rat Tails for a snack.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著：給我30條鼠尾當零食。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 5 on the note... 5 of what? What?! Lemons?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫了個“5”……五個什麼？什麼？！檸檬？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Give us 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams!! Heh~ I personally prefer Ice Cream, just so you know.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～給我們10塊冰塊或10個冰淇淋！！嘿嘿～先告訴你，我個人更喜歡冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here, I found the note from our team. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～找到了，這是我們隊員留的紙條。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿？！{0}，這裡沒有你的委託紙條。嘿嘿～你想彙報什麼？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says in the note to bring 30 Phens and 10 Fish Tails. Heh~ Maybe you didn't catch enough Phens, or forgot some Fish Tails? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著要帶30條水母和10條魚尾。嘿嘿～你是不是沒抓夠水母，或者忘了帶魚尾？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ But, where are 50 Marses and 30 Milk Bottles? Heh~ Please see if you haven't missed them...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～那50只烏賊和30瓶牛奶呢？嘿嘿～請檢查一下是不是漏帶了……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says on the note, harass 30 Kobold Archers. Heh~ Please check if you have harassed 30 of them already.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著要騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手。嘿嘿～請確認一下你是不是已經騷擾夠30只了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh? Where are those 10 Cramps you promised? Heh~ You didn't eat them... did you?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿？說好的10只藍鼠呢？嘿嘿～你該不會把它們吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those Peco Pecos? Still not ready? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～那些大嘴鳥呢？還沒準備好嗎？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 20 yarns? It says 20 on the note, right...? Please check if you have lost them somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～那20團毛線呢？紙條上寫的是20團，對吧……？請檢查一下是不是弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 30 Rat Tails? Please check and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～那30條鼠尾呢？請檢查好再過來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let's just get 5 Lemons for them, will you? Heh~ I am still not sure where they want to use them...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～給他們買5個檸檬，好嗎？嘿嘿～我還是不太明白他們拿檸檬要做什麼……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are the Ice Pieces or Ice Creams? You should get them before they melt...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～冰塊或冰淇淋呢？趁它們還沒融化，趕快準備好……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eryu together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eryu already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著“我們要一起去見埃留”。嘿嘿～你已經見過埃留了嗎？我看還沒有吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Stew together.'. Heh~ Have you met Stew already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著“我們要一起去見斯圖”。嘿嘿～你已經見過斯圖了嗎？我看還沒有吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Ketchup together.'. Heh~ Have you met Ketchup already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著“我們要一起去見番茄醬”。嘿嘿～你已經見過番茄醬了嗎？我看還沒有吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eff together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eff already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～紙條上寫著“我們要一起去見埃夫”。嘿嘿～你已經見過埃夫了嗎？我看還沒有吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿？！{0}，這裡沒有你的委託紙條。嘿嘿～你想彙報什麼？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thanks for coming by, {0}. Heh~ Keep up the good work. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家協會負責人]
嘿嘿～謝謝你特地過來，{0}。嘿嘿～繼續加油。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Strange Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的貓]
喵～喵嗚～嗷嗷～喵嗚喵～嗷嗷～

scripts.text: Some strange cat is here.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一隻奇怪的貓。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
喵～喵嗚～嗷嗷～喵嗚喵～嗷嗷～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你想做什麼？

scripts.text: Ask about the team's attitude...
scripts.translation: 詢問隊伍的狀況……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Do not lie to me! How can I trust you and reveal our team secret? Aren't you a spy from the doggy team?
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
別騙我！我怎麼能相信你，把隊伍的秘密告訴你？你是狗隊派來的間諜吧？

scripts.text: Aww, come on...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，拜託……

scripts.text: You play with a foxtail nearby and then ask again.
scripts.translation: 你在附近拿著貓尾草逗貓玩，然後再問一次。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director says...
scripts.translation: 貓玩家協會負責人說……

scripts.text: The Manager Cat seems to be interested in the foxtail and starts answering.
scripts.translation: 貓管理員似乎對貓尾草很感興趣，開始回答你的問題。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Players are afraid of the Cat Gamers Director. When they see Cat Gamers Director at the game, they get nervous.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
隊員們都怕貓玩家協會負責人。只要他出現在比賽現場，大家就會緊張起來。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Can you give me that?
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
那個能給我嗎？

scripts.text: You hand the foxtail to the Manager Cat. Go back to the Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation: 你把貓尾草遞給貓管理員，然後返回貓玩家協會負責人那裡。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie to me!
Why should I trust you,
and give our team information?
Aren't you a spy from doggy team...?
Go away.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
別騙我！
我為什麼要相信你，
把隊伍的情報告訴你？
你是狗隊派來的間諜吧……？
走開。

scripts.text: This cat might hit you.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓可能會揍你。

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
貓管理員正在玩你給他的貓尾草。
他似乎很喜歡……

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
貓管理員正在玩你給他的貓尾草。
他似乎很喜歡……

scripts.text: Help~ Fire~
scripts.translation: 救命～著火了～

scripts.text: Hey~!
Do you want to hear something?
scripts.translation: 想聽點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie~ We don't use fire that much~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
別騙人～我們沒怎麼用火～

scripts.text: The Manager Cat ignores you, and keeps on playing with the foxtail.
scripts.translation: 貓管理員沒有理你，繼續玩著貓尾草。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ I want to tell you a story~ Follow me meow~ Let talk over there, meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
喵～我想給你講個故事～跟我來，喵～我們去那邊聊，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha, I was just kidding. I actually need to tell you that the Cat Gamers Director has an issue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈，我開玩笑的。其實我得告訴你，貓玩家協會負責人遇到點麻煩……

scripts.text: You explain the story to the Manager Cat.
scripts.translation: 你把事情經過告訴了貓管理員。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scary image... Meow, I understand... Cat Gamers Director should feel peace by giving up things.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
可怕的形象……喵，我明白了……讓貓玩家協會負責人放下一些執念，心裡就能平靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow! Go tell him this, meow~ Prepare a box, meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
喵！把這個辦法告訴他，喵～準備一個箱子，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A box?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一個箱子？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Petition it is, meow!! There is some place where humans do such things, I think it will help us~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
就是請願箱，喵！！我記得人類有地方會這麼做，應該能幫上忙～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, I will go tell it to the Games Director~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我這就去告訴貓玩家協會負責人～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You tell the Cat Gamers Director to prepare a Box for sure!~ I will tell this to my team, meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你一定要告訴貓玩家協會負責人準備一個箱子！～我會把這事告訴隊員們，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The players are excited and writing a bunch of things for the petition box... I wonder what they are writing.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
隊員們正興奮地往請願箱裡寫東西呢……真想知道他們都寫了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You won't help practice? If you help, the Cat Gamers Director will give you food cans... Please reconsider!
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你不願意幫忙訓練嗎？你來幫忙的話，貓玩家協會負責人會給你罐頭……請再考慮一下！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Aren't you {0}? I heard Cat Gamers Director ordered a special certificate, meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
喵～你是{0}吧？我聽說貓玩家協會負責人訂做了一張特別的證書，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When practicing, you must equip the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' item~ Don't forget, meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
訓練時必須裝備“^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000”喔～別忘了，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want meow?
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你想做什麼，喵？

scripts.text: Hi.
scripts.translation: 你好。

scripts.text: Any news?
scripts.translation: 有什麼新訊息嗎？

scripts.text: Help me with playing.
scripts.translation: 幫我練習遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh, hi meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
哦，你好呀，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
I tell you this meow~ You don't know Cat Gamers Director's feeling meow~.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
我告訴你吧，喵～你不瞭解貓玩家協會負責人的心情，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
lol? >> Curious, Admire
Heh~ >> Normal
lol Heh~ >> Happy
lol lol Heh~ >> Crazy meow
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
哈哈？ >> 好奇、羨慕
嘿嘿～ >> 普通
哈哈，嘿嘿～ >> 開心
哈哈哈哈，嘿嘿～ >> 瘋狂，喵

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
But, why are you asking me meow? Strange meow...
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
不過，你為什麼問我呢，喵？真奇怪，喵……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Some cats use 'meow meow' like me when talking, but some don't.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
有些貓說話時會像我一樣“喵喵”叫，但也有些貓不會。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Cats don't have an honorific phrase, so don't get us wrong as looking down on you meow.~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
貓沒有敬語，所以別誤會我們是在看不起你，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should walk around many places and ask for information meow... But, don't bother me please meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你應該到處走走，打聽些訊息，喵……不過請別來煩我，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
No easy way for that... I just breathe meow...
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
這種事沒有捷徑……我只要呼吸就行了，喵……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What game do you want to play?
'Cat Gamers' has players for 4 types of games meow~
The Cat Gamers Director said he will challenge other games later~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你想玩什麼遊戲？
“貓玩家”協會裡有四種遊戲的選手，喵～
協會負責人說以後還會挑戰其他遊戲，喵～

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors
scripts.translation: 石頭剪刀布

scripts.text: KongNyangKong
scripts.translation: 碰拳猜方向

scripts.text: ChamChamCham
scripts.translation: 猜猜看

scripts.text: Flag Game
scripts.translation: 奪旗

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Rock Paper Scissors meow? Nothing special...
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
石頭剪刀布嗎，喵？沒什麼特別的……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scissor beats Paper, meow.
Rock beats Scissors, meow.
Paper beats Rock, meow.
These are basic rules.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
剪刀勝布，喵。
石頭勝剪刀，喵。
布勝石頭，喵。
這就是基本規則。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You play 5 Rock Paper Scissors games with player cats meow.
You play again when you are even meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你要和貓玩家對戰五局石頭剪刀布，喵。
平局的話就重賽，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can get a present after 3 times of winning meow.
And you get a big present when you win all 5 matches, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
贏三局就能拿到禮物，喵。
五局全勝的話，還有大獎，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Find Paa or Ser if you want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
想玩石頭剪刀布的話，就去找帕阿或塞爾。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
KongNyangKong is not an easy game meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
碰拳猜方向可不是簡單的遊戲，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When attacking, face your hand the same direction as the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
進攻時，手勢要和對手的方向相同，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When defending, you should face your hand the opposite direction from the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
防守時，手勢要和對手的方向相反，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If the attack is a success, you can keep on attacking.
But, if you fail, you have to defend meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
進攻成功就能繼續攻擊。
如果失敗，就得轉為防守，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you be careful, you can win without getting hit at all meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
只要小心應對，甚至可以不受傷就贏，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Once you make your opponent's HP 0, you win meow.
Of course there will be a present meow.
Good luck meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
把對手的HP降到0就算獲勝，喵。
當然也有禮物拿，喵。
祝你好運，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh~ right meow~!! Find KungKung if you want to play KongNyangKong.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
哦，對了，喵～想玩碰拳猜方向的話，就去找孔孔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
ChamChamCham is a high level mind game meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
猜猜看是高階的心理戰，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The rules are simple, but you need to think a lot meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
規則很簡單，但得多動腦筋，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should direct your hand to where the cat turns its face meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
你要把手指向貓轉頭的方向，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
A present is given for 3 wins in a row meow.
The more wins, the more presents meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
連續贏三次就能拿到禮物，喵。
贏得越多，禮物也越多，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Kuka is smart, and remembers players with many wins meow.
There will be more presents when you take 1st place meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
庫卡很聰明，會記住贏過很多次的玩家，喵。
拿到第一名的話，禮物會更多，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Flag Game is way harder than ChamChamCham game meow.
Really~ Really~ Really~
hard mind game meow.
It's 1,000 times harder meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
奪旗比猜猜看難得多，喵。
真的～真的～真的～
是場燒腦的心理戰，喵。
難上一千倍，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You get 5 Flag Point when starting meow.
1 point goes away when you wave the flag once meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
開始時你有五點旗分，喵。
每揮一次旗就會扣一點，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You win the game when no other cats are waving flags meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
其他貓都不揮旗時，你就贏了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can predict if other cats will wave their flags or not meow.
By looking at their actions meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
觀察其他貓的行動，
就能預測它們會不會揮旗，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You must win to get presents meow.
You will get more presents since this is hard game meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
必須獲勝才能拿到禮物，喵。
這遊戲很難，所以獲勝後能拿更多禮物，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you want to play Flag Game meow~
Go find the other manager cat who is trying to get the Referee Certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[貓管理員]
想玩奪旗的話，喵～
就去找另一位正在考取裁判證的貓管理員，喵。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: You found Eryu the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了貓咪埃留，便上前搭話。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
呃……你是誰？

scripts.text: The Games Director sent me.
scripts.translation: 協會負責人派我來的。

scripts.text: I am a writer for the 'Human' magazine.
scripts.translation: 我是《人類》雜誌的撰稿人。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Arrgg. Go away...
I don't know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊……走開……
我不知道你在說誰。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm? 'Human' magazine?
Is there such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯？《人類》雜誌？
真有這種東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We've been publishing for 10 years.
But, I guess it is possible for cats to not know who we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們已經發行十年了。
不過貓咪不知道我們，倒也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are a really famous magazine throughout the World!
Don't you believe me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們可是風靡全世界的知名雜誌！
你不信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Hmm... ok. But, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯……好吧。你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in the middle of writing an article named 'Game Playing Cats'...'
It is a special piece for me.
And some team named umm... do... umm... wal... not sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在寫一篇題為《愛玩遊戲的貓》的報道……
這篇報道對我意義非凡。
還有個隊伍叫……嗯……狗……嗯……華爾……我記不太清了……

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
'Dog n Waltz'?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
“狗與華爾茲”？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Yes!
One of players there 'Dog n Waltz' has recommended Eryu for an interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！沒錯！
“狗與華爾茲”隊裡有人推薦我來採訪埃留。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He says you are a really good player who can help me with the article.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說你是位很出色的玩家，能幫我完成這篇報道。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I don't remember anyone from 'Dog n Waltz' that much.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我不太記得“狗與華爾茲”隊裡的人了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The person isn't important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個人不重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just answer a few questions for me, ok?
Be yourself and you'll do just fine.
Ok, first question: How much do you practice a day?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要回答我幾個問題，好嗎？
照實回答就行。
第一個問題：你每天練習多久？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Usually for about 8 hours, but I have to tell you that I'm not on the team anymore...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
通常練八個小時左右。不過我得告訴你，我已經不在隊裡了……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what?
You are not with the team now? How come...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，什麼？
你現在不在隊裡了？怎麼回事……？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Well...
The Director Cat was too scary...
I was very sick and had to take a day off...
Just one freaking day...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
唉……
協會負責人實在太嚇人了……
有一次我病得很重，只好請了一天假……
就一天而已啊……

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
And then the Director Cat was raging at me!
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
結果協會負責人衝我大發雷霆！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, sounds pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，聽起來真不好受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Cat Gamers' has lost another great player.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not on the team anymore.
I guess this is the end of the interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
“貓玩家”又失去了一位優秀選手。
聽說你已經離隊，我也很遺憾。
看來採訪只能到此為止了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because this is for current players only.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這次採訪只面向現役選手。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Oh...
Sorry to make you waste your time.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
哦……
害你白跑一趟了，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, don't worry.
I should say sorry for taking up your precious time.
Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。該道歉的是我，佔用了你寶貴的時間。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
You found out the reason why Eryu left the team.
Time to go find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你弄清了埃留離隊的原因。
該去找其他貓咪了。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Yes, I am Eryu! What do you want, huh, meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
沒錯，我就是埃留！找我有什麼事，喵～

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the magazine writer?
What brings you here again...?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那個雜誌記者嗎？
怎麼又回來了……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah!
Sorry, I was trying to interview another cat...
And came back to you by mistake.
I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！
抱歉，我本來要去採訪另一隻貓……
結果不小心又走到你這裡了。
不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Ah... I see. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊……我知道了。路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你是誰？

scripts.text: What do you want to say?
scripts.translation: 你想說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
What is this? What do you mean by '{0}'...?
Ah... aren't you the writer?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
這是什麼？你說“{0}”是什麼意思……？
啊……你不是那個記者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... Who is that..?

Eryu seems to recognize you.
{0}
scripts.translation:
埃留似乎認出了你。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I think you are the writer...
Hey~ Stop there~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我想起來了，你是那個記者……
嘿～別跑～

scripts.text: You've been found. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 被發現了，快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Dirty 'Cat Gamers'!
I won't go back ever... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
可惡的“貓玩家”！
我絕不會回去……你是誰？

scripts.text: This cat might hit you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓可能會揍你，快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the writer?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那個記者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... Who is that..?
Eryu seems to recognize you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃留似乎認出了你，快逃吧。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: You found Stew the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了貓咪斯圖，便上前搭話。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow...? Who are you, meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵……？你是誰，喵？

scripts.text: The 'Cat Gamers' Manager sent me.
scripts.translation: “貓玩家”協會的管理員讓我來的。

scripts.text: Meow~ Grrr~
scripts.translation: 喵～嗚……

scripts.text: I'm with the 'Boom Can' Company.
scripts.translation: 我是“罐頭罐頭”公司的。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Stew is not interested meow.
Don't come back again meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
斯圖沒興趣，喵。
別再來了，喵～

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Stew doesn't have time for crazy people.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
斯圖沒空理瘋子。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
'Boom Can' Company, meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
“罐頭罐頭”公司，喵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't know 'Boom Can' food?
You don't eat canned food at all?
Then, I came to the wrong cat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你沒聽說過“罐頭罐頭”的食品嗎？
你完全不吃罐頭嗎？
那我找錯貓了。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Yes meow~ Stew likes canned food very much meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
是啊，喵～斯圖最喜歡吃罐頭了，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! Ok then.

[{0}]
We, the 'Boom Can' Company, have been servicing for over 10 years, so we are doing a survey for better food production.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們“罐頭罐頭”公司經營了十多年，現在正在做調查，好把食品做得更好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me ask a few questions.
It is very easy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想問你幾個問題，很簡單的。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Ok meow~ Go ahead meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
好呀，喵～儘管問，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you! We were right about out cat customers with big hearts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝！看來我們沒看錯，貓咪顧客都很熱心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met dog customers last week and they didn't answer me at all...
And they were so rude~ You know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我上週去拜訪狗狗顧客，他們完全不理我……
態度還特別差～你知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Dogs are natually like that~
You humans know animals~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
狗狗天生就那樣，喵～
你們人類不是很瞭解動物嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you! I'm flattered.~
Ok, let me ask you a few things.
What is your job?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝誇獎，我都不好意思了～
好，我來問你幾個問題。
你的職業是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Job meow? Stew was a pro gamer meow~
But, Stew quit now meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
職業，喵？斯圖以前是職業玩家，喵～
不過現在已經退役了，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, how did that happen?
You seem to have good skills.
Fast and big hearted, its a pity that you quit already.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎麼會這樣？
你的技術看起來很好啊。
動作敏捷，心地又好，退役真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow~ Meow~ Meow~ Yes, Stew was something meow.
If it was not for that Cat Gamers Director scaring me, Stew would still be playing meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵～喵～喵～是啊，斯圖以前可厲害了，喵。
要不是貓玩家協會負責人把斯圖嚇壞了，我現在還在比賽呢，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What a bad Director.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真是個糟糕的負責人。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Not that bad actually meow~
Sometimes.. Stew gets very tired meow.
So, Stew takes it easy while practicing meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
其實他也沒那麼壞，喵～
有時候斯圖會特別累，喵。
所以訓練時斯圖會稍微放鬆一下，喵。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Then the Cat Gamers Director started to get angry and scary meow.
So I quit meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
後來貓玩家協會負責人就開始發火，變得很嚇人，喵。
所以斯圖退隊了，喵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! I see.
Ok, the survey is over now.
Thank you for your opinion on our survey for the 'Boom Can' company.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！我明白了。
好，調查到此結束。
感謝你為“罐頭罐頭”公司的調查提供意見。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow? Did you aks anything meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵？你剛才問了什麼，喵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I already asked you everything...
Don't you remember?
There were 10 questions!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經問完所有問題了……
你不記得了嗎？
一共問了十個問題呢！

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Really meow? Strange meow.
Sorry meow? Don't remember meow.
It didn't felt like an interview meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
真的嗎，喵？真奇怪，喵。
抱歉，喵？我不記得了，喵。
剛才感覺一點都不像在接受採訪，喵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well you did way better than those dogs.
I don't even want to think about them~ Phew~..
I should get going now.
Have a great day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可比那些狗強多了。
我都不想再提它們了～唉～
我該走了。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Really meow? Dogs are always like that meow.
Cats are winners meow~
Ok meow~ Good bye meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
真的嗎，喵？狗就是那樣，喵。
貓才是贏家，喵～
好吧，喵～再見，喵～

scripts.text:
You found out the reason why Stew left the team.
Let's find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你弄清了斯圖離隊的原因。
去找其他貓咪吧。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Aren't you from the 'Boom Can' Company?
Another survey meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
你不是“罐頭罐頭”公司的人嗎？
又來做調查，喵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops! I should be meeting other cats.
I am very sorry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀！我還得去見其他貓咪。
真不好意思……

scripts.text:
[Stew]
It's ok meow~ Good bye meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
沒關係，喵～再見，喵～

scripts.text:
[Stew]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打個招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! Ok, hi? But, why now?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！好吧，你好？不過現在打招呼是為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... You are bored? Why don't you play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
啊……你覺得無聊嗎？要不要和我玩一局？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, you! Don't neglect the Rock Paper Scissors game!!
I've seen many people getting their butts kicked in this game!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
喂！別小看石頭剪刀布！！
我見過很多人在這遊戲裡輸得很慘！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You better mark my words, if you don't want to end up like them!~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
記住我的話，免得落得和他們一樣的下場！～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You don't even know how to play this game?
Let me kindly teach you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你連怎麼玩都不知道嗎？
我就大發慈悲教教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Scissors beats Paper,
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
剪刀勝布，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Paper beats Rock,
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
布勝石頭，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
And Rock beats Scissors.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
石頭勝剪刀。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok? Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
懂了嗎？明白了吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You must play 5 matches with me.
We go again if the game is even!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你得和我比五局。
如果平局，就重賽！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I will give you a present if you beat me 3 times. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你要是贏我三局，我就送你禮物。怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok, then. Go away.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好，就這樣。走吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Result is even, so we play again.
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
第{0}局～～
平局了，所以我們再比一次。
加油！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
第{0}局～～
加油！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾與{0}]
石頭！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石頭

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Ser]
All 5 matches are over!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
五局都結束了！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm... Let me see...
I won {0} times, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯……我算算……
我贏了{0}局，你贏了{2}局，{1}，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has won the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
{0}贏了。

scripts.text: Ser became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 塞爾忽然變得彬彬有禮。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Great game it was. I admire your enthusiasm for the game. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
這場比賽真精彩。我很欣賞你對遊戲的熱情，所以想把我珍藏的罐頭送給你。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Just take it!! Do as I say~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
拿著吧！！聽我的～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You are polite. But, sadly this is all I can give you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你真有禮貌。不過很遺憾，我能給你的就只有這些了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
Oh! You won all 5 matches. Here are some more extra Cans.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
再見～明天再來練習吧～
哦！你五局全勝了。這些額外的罐頭也給你。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
再見～明天再來練習吧～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has lost. Ha... Ha...
Ser became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 塞爾變得十分傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You want to play with me? Ser? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你想和我玩？和塞爾？就憑你那點本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What? Present? How can you ask for such a thing when you lose? Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
什麼？還想要禮物？輸了還敢要禮物？去多練習！！努力！！對，我就該讓你去練！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯，你知道一種叫水母的魚嗎？知道吧？看起來很好吃，對吧？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Ser wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕嚕 -
塞爾擦掉嘴邊的口水。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
去抓30只水母，再給我拿10條魚尾。把它們交給貓玩家協會負責人，他會做一道美味的料理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
最近我總覺得提不起勁，身上的擔子也太重了。得好好保養身體才行。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Now it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
現在該吃點健康的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
給貓玩家協會負責人送50只烏賊和25瓶牛奶。他很懂健康飲食。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Well... we do have a rival, you know. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯……我們有個對手，你知道吧？他們叫“狗與華爾茲”，一齣現就沒好事。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal... So, please at least harass similar looking monsters. What would be a good target?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我本想叫你去欺負他們，不過那可能違法……至少去找些長得像他們的魔物出出氣吧。該找誰好呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
啊，就是犬妖弓箭手！！我最討厭那些傢伙了。去騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What is most important for winning the game? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
想贏比賽，最重要的是什麼？是速度。怎麼才能變快呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I've been thinking... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我一直在想……對我們貓來說，抓老鼠當然是最好的訓練方法。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You know Cramp, right? That blue chubby creature... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你知道藍鼠吧？就是那種藍色、胖乎乎的傢伙……去抓10只，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... I want some bird cuisine. Which one would be most delicious?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
啊……我想吃鳥肉料理。哪種鳥最好吃呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Picky? Ah! It's too small. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
小雞？啊，太小了。禿鷹怎麼樣？不太確定……大嘴鳥？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Alright! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好！去抓50只大嘴鳥，交給貓玩家協會負責人。今晚我們要開一場鳥肉料理派對。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I get too nervous before the game. And I don't play well when I'm nervous. I need something to calm down before the game starts.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我每次賽前都特別緊張，一緊張就發揮不好。比賽開始前，我得找點東西讓自己冷靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! That's right! Yarn! I used to play with Yarn when I was young. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers'.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！對了！毛線球！我小時候常玩毛線球。加入“貓玩家”之後，就再也沒能像那樣放鬆過了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 20 Yarns for me. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue. Our Director should take care of this for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我找20團毛線。為什麼要20團？還有很多貓也有同樣的問題。貓玩家協會負責人會幫你處理的。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses. Or is the manager taking advantage?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
最近協會負責人好像在想辦法削減開支。還是說管理員在趁機撈好處？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
隊員們的日常零食被削減了。你去找30條鼠尾，交給貓玩家協會負責人吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
這樣就能查出我們的管理員是不是在貪便宜了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I am having a slump these days. I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我最近狀態不太好，比賽時總是發揮不出全部實力。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
It is the lemon we need in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
這種時候就需要檸檬。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 5 lemons for me. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我拿5個檸檬。別忘了，是5個……貓玩家協會負責人應該知道怎麼處理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets very hot when we play games.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
綿綿島很適合貓咪生活，不過比賽時會熱得受不了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
比賽打得久了，簡直熱得發狂，讓貓都受不了。你也知道貓有多容易激動吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我們拿10塊冰塊或10個冰淇淋。貓玩家協會負責人應該知道怎麼處理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
看起來你也需要休息。放鬆一會兒吧。要不要在村裡散散步？我堅持這麼認為～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
不過光在村裡散步也沒意思。嗯……對了！！去見一隻叫埃留的貓怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！見到那隻貓時，記得說“回來”。這是暗號。還有，別忘了告訴協會負責人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
看起來你也需要休息。放鬆一會兒吧。要不要在村裡散散步？我堅持這麼認為～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Stew?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
不過光在村裡散步也沒意思。嗯……對了！！去見一隻叫斯圖的貓怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ser]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Ketchup?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
不過光在村裡散步也沒意思。嗯……對了！！去見一隻叫番茄醬的貓怎麼樣？

scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
看起來你也需要休息。放鬆一會兒吧。要不要在村裡散散步？我堅持這麼認為～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eff?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
不過光在村裡散步也沒意思。嗯……對了！！去見一隻叫埃夫的貓怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！見到那隻貓時，記得說“回來”。這是暗號。還有，別忘了告訴協會負責人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You haven't done what we asked you for meow. A promise is a promise, you know meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你還沒完成我們拜託的事呢，喵。一諾千金，懂嗎，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When you are done meow, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
做完之後記得去那邊找貓玩家協會負責人確認，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You seem like a first timer meow! Where did you get the certificate meow? Someone lost it, I guess meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起來是第一次來，喵！證書是從哪兒弄來的，喵？大概是有人弄丟了吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When is our practicing partner coming meow? I am bored meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我們的練習搭檔什麼時候來呀，喵？我都無聊了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，喵？想玩石頭剪刀布嗎，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate meow? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你的貓玩家證書呢，喵？看起來不起眼，可沒有它就不能玩這個遊戲，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go get the certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
先去拿到證書再來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We can only play the game once a day meow. Come tomorrow meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我們一天只能玩一次，喵。明天再來吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，喵？想玩石頭剪刀布嗎，喵？

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 開始遊戲

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打個招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good idea meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好主意，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hello meow~ Nice to see you meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你好呀～見到你真高興，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Other games have one cat player. But, we have two for Rock Paper Scissors. You want to know why meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
其他遊戲都只有一位貓選手。只有石頭剪刀布有兩位。想知道為什麼嗎，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Paa is kind meow. So, I'll tell you story meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
因為帕阿很善良，喵。所以我來給你講個故事，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Ser cat is my twin brother. I was born first, but he always says he is the elder meow. But, I don't fight with Ser meow. I am a good brother meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
塞爾是我的雙胞胎弟弟。我先出生，可他總說自己才是哥哥，喵。不過我從不和塞爾爭，喵。我是個好哥哥，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Anyways, me and Ser are well known as the pro gamer cat brothers meow. Everyone knows us meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
總之，我和塞爾可是有名的職業玩家兄弟，喵。大家都認識我們，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are free to admire me, meow. I give you permission meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你可以盡情崇拜我，喵。我准許了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to know how to play this game meow? I'll teach you because I am a kind cat meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
想知道怎麼玩嗎，喵？我這隻善良的貓會教你的，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You don't seem that stupid meow. So, let's skip the part about what beats what meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起來沒那麼笨，喵。誰克誰的部分就跳過吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You must play 5 matches with me meow. We go again if the game is even meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你得和我比五局，喵。平局的話就重賽，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
If you win 3 times, I'll give you a present meow~ Cat Gamers Director said so meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你要是贏三局，我就送你禮物，喵～這是貓玩家協會負責人說的，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
That is all meow~ But it is not an easy game meow. Respect the game meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
就這些，喵～不過這遊戲可不簡單，喵。要認真對待，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Result is even, so we play again meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局～～喵。
平局了，所以我們再比一次，喵。
加油，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局～～喵。
加油，喵！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾與{0}]
石頭！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石頭

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Meow!! All 5 matches are over meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
喵！！五局都結束了，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Let me see meow...
I won {0} times meow, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
讓我算算，喵……
我贏了{0}局，你贏了{2}局，{1}，對吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You won meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你贏了，喵。

scripts.text: Paa became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 帕阿忽然變得彬彬有禮。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Great game it was meow. I admire your enthusiasm for the game meow. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
這局打得真精彩，喵。我很欣賞你對遊戲的熱情，喵。所以想把我珍藏的罐頭送給你，喵。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Just take it meow!! Do as I say meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
拿著吧，喵！！聽我的，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are polite meow. But, sadly this is all I can give you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你真有禮貌，喵。不過很遺憾，我能給你的就只有這些了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
Oh! You won all 5 matches meow. Here are some more extra Cans meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再見，喵～明天再來練習吧，喵～
哦！你五局全勝了，喵。這些額外的罐頭也給你，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再見，喵～明天再來練習吧，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You lost. Meow... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你輸了，喵……喵……

scripts.text: Paa became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 帕阿變得十分傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to play with me? Paa? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想和我玩？和帕阿？就憑你那點本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What? Present meow? How can you ask for such a thing meow? You lost meow! Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
什麼？還想要禮物，喵？輸了還敢要禮物，喵？去多練習！！努力！！對，我就該讓你去練，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen meow? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
嗯，你知道一種叫水母的魚嗎，喵？知道吧？看起來很好吃，對吧，喵？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Paa wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕嚕 -
帕阿擦掉嘴邊的口水。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go catch 30 Phens meow. And also get me 10 Fish Tails meow. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓30只水母，喵。再給我拿10條魚尾，喵。把它們交給貓玩家協會負責人，他會做成美味料理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me meow. I should take care of my health meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近我總覺得提不起勁，身上的擔子也太重了，喵。得好好保養身體，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Now it's time for some healthy food meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
現在該吃點健康的東西了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director meow. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
給貓玩家協會負責人送50只烏賊和25瓶牛奶，喵。他很懂健康飲食，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We do have a rival, you know meow. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我們有個對手，你知道吧，喵？他們叫“狗與華爾茲”，一齣現就沒好事，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal meow... So, I will ask you to harass similar looking monsters meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我本想叫你去欺負他們，但那可能違法，喵……所以請去騷擾長得像他們的魔物，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds meow!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
啊，就是犬妖弓箭手，喵！！我最討厭那些傢伙了。去騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What is most important for winning the game meow? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
想贏比賽，最重要的是什麼，喵？是速度。我們該怎麼變快呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I've been thinking meow... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我一直在想，喵……對我們貓來說，抓老鼠當然是最好的辦法，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You know Cramp, right meow? That blue chubby creature meow... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道藍鼠吧，喵？就是那種藍色、胖乎乎的傢伙，喵……去抓10只，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Chrub... I want some bird cuisine meow. Which one would be most delicious meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
咕嚕……我想吃鳥肉料理，喵。哪種鳥最好吃呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Picky? Ah! It's too small meow. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
小雞？啊，太小了，喵。禿鷹怎麼樣？不太確定……大嘴鳥呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Alright meow! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director meow. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好，喵！去抓50只大嘴鳥，交給貓玩家協會負責人，喵。今晚我們要開一場鳥肉料理派對，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I get too nervous before the game meow. And I don't play well when I'm nervous meow. I need something to calm down before the game starts meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我每次賽前都特別緊張，喵。一緊張就發揮不好，喵。比賽開始前，我得找點東西讓自己冷靜下來，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! That's right meow! Yarn meow! I used to play with Yarn when I was young meow. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers' meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！對了，喵！毛線，喵！我小時候常玩毛線，喵。加入“貓玩家”後，就再也沒法那樣放鬆了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Please get 20 Yarns for me meow. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue meow. Our Director should take care of this for you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
請幫我找20團毛線，喵。為什麼要20團？還有很多貓也有同樣的問題，喵。貓玩家協會負責人會幫你處理的，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses meow. Or is the manager taking advantage meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近協會負責人好像在想辦法削減開支，喵。還是說管理員在趁機撈好處，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced meow. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
隊員們的日常零食被削減了，喵。去找30條鼠尾，交給貓玩家協會負責人吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
這樣就能查出我們的管理員是不是在貪便宜了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I am having a slump these days meow. I can't give my 100% to the game meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我最近狀態不太好，比賽時總是發揮不出全部實力，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
It is the lemon we need in times like this meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
這種時候就需要檸檬，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 5 lemons for me meow. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons meow... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
給我拿5個檸檬，喵。別忘了，是5個，喵……貓玩家協會負責人應該知道怎麼處理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live meow. But, it gets very hot when we play games meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
綿綿島很適合貓咪生活，喵。不過比賽時會熱得受不了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear meow. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
比賽打得久了，簡直熱得發狂，讓貓都受不了，喵。你也知道貓有多容易激動吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get me either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
給我拿10塊冰塊或10個冰淇淋，喵。貓玩家協會負責人應該知道怎麼處理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
看起來你也需要休息，喵。放鬆一會兒吧，喵。去村裡散散步怎麼樣，喵？我堅持這麼認為，喵～！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
不過光在村裡散步也沒意思，喵。嗯……對了，喵！！去見一隻叫埃留的貓怎麼樣，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！見到那隻貓時，記得說“回來”，喵。這是暗號，喵。還有，別忘了告訴協會負責人，我一直都和你在一起，喵！！

scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You haven't done what we asked you for yo~. A promise is a promise, you know yo~.
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
你還沒完成我們拜託的事呢～答應過的事就要做到，知道嗎～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there yo.~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
做完後請去那邊找貓玩家協會負責人確認哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You seem like a first timer yo~ Where did you get the certificate yo~ You better give that back yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
你看起來是第一次來～證書是從哪兒弄來的？最好把它還回去哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
The Cat Gamers Director said a practicing partner is coming yo~ But, that human didn't show up yo~ I am bored yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
貓玩家協會負責人說練習搭檔要來了～可是那個人類沒出現～我好無聊哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
哦，了不起的成員^0000FF{0}^000000～來玩“猜猜看”吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
But, you don't have the certificate yo~ Certificate helps you save the game record yo~ You must have it! yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
不過你沒有證書哦～證書能儲存遊戲記錄～一定要帶著哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Please go get the certificate yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
請先去拿到證書哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Is it not tomorrow yet yo~ You can play one game a day yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
還沒到明天哦～一天只能玩一局～明天再來吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
哦，了不起的成員^0000FF{0}^000000～來玩“猜猜看”吧～

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 開始遊戲

scripts.text: Ask who is 1st place.
scripts.translation: 詢問誰是第一名

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Good choice yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
選得好哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
No one holds a record for the ChamChamCham game yo~
You could be the first yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
“猜猜看”目前還沒有人創下紀錄哦～
你可以成為第一個哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
Never know when someone else would break the record yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
“猜猜看”目前的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，連勝^DE2B21{1}^000000局哦～
不知道什麼時候會有人打破紀錄呢～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
I expect that you, {2}, can beat ^0000FF{3}^000000 sometime yo~

[Kuka]
ChamChamCham game rules are very simple yo~
Just direct your hand towards the direction where I direct my face yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
“猜猜看”的規則很簡單哦～
只要把手指向我轉頭的方向就行了～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Like this yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
像這樣哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Or like that yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
或者像那樣哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
A present is available for 3 wins yo~
If you beat the previous record, you get a bigger present yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
連勝三局就有禮物哦～
打破之前的紀錄，還能拿到更大的禮物哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
See you at the practice yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
練習時見哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham!
scripts.translation:
[庫卡與{0}]
猜！

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham! Cham!
scripts.translation:
[庫卡與{0}]
猜！猜！

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham! Cham! Cham!
scripts.translation:
[庫卡與{0}]
猜！猜！猜！

scripts.text: Hand towards left
scripts.translation: 手指向左

scripts.text: Hand towards right
scripts.translation: 手指向右

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Hehe~ I won yo~ I feel good yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
嘿嘿～我贏了～真開心～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Well~ I lost yo~ Let's practice more yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
哎呀～我輸了～再多練練吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
{0} has won {1} times yo~ Next game starts yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
{0}贏了{1}局～開始下一局～

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
比賽開始前，我們會擲骰子決定誰先出手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Why do you want to know the 1st place? KongNyangKong is a brutal and tough match game. Kuka should know such thing!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你打聽第一名做什麼？“碰碰撞”可是場激烈又殘酷的比賽。這種事該問庫卡才對！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You want to learn the game rules?
You seem to have a polite way of asking things.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想了解遊戲規則？
你問得還挺有禮貌。
仔細聽好了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
KongNyangKong has different play rules when attacking and defending.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
“碰碰撞”在進攻和防守時有不同的規則。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
When attacking, you must turn your hand to the same side as your opponent in order to complete the attack.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
進攻時，你必須把手轉向和對手相同的一邊，才能成功攻擊。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If we turn our hands the same way like this, then your attack is successful.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
像這樣把手轉向同一邊，你的攻擊就成功了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
For defending, you must turn your hand to the opposite side of your opponent in order to defend yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
防守時，你必須把手轉向和對手相反的一邊，才能保護自己。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Yes! If you turn your hand opposite to mine like that, you have succeeded defending yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
沒錯！像這樣把手轉向和我相反的一邊，就成功防守了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If you are clever enough, you should know that the bottom hand is the attacker's hand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
聰明的話，你應該看得出來，下面那隻手屬於進攻方。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Last!! Most important rule.
Once you succeed attacking, you can continue attacking your opponent.
When you fail, then you are on the defending side.
Do not forget this!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
最後，也是最重要的規則：
進攻成功後，可以繼續攻擊對手。
如果失敗，就輪到你防守。
千萬別忘了！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You can ask about the KongNyangKong rules anytime you want!
Our Manager Cat also knows all about the KongNyangKong rules.
That is all!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
隨時都可以來問我“碰碰撞”的規則！
貓管理員也很熟悉這遊戲的規則。
就這些！

scripts.text:

我可能練習過度了……渾身無力，肩上的擔子也很重。得好好保養身體。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我已經十歲了，該吃點健康的東西了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

[孔孔]
我們有個對手，就是“狗與華爾茲”隊……他們一來就沒好事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

scripts.text:

Go harass 30 Kobold Archers instead of 'Dog n Waltz', and report to our Cat Gamers Director.

scripts.text:

Quickness is most important for winning the game. For better quickness...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想贏比賽，速度最重要。要提高速度的話……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catching mice is best. It's Cramp hunting time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓老鼠最好。該去抓藍鼠了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 10 Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓10只藍鼠，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want some bird cuisine. Have you tasted any before?
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想吃鳥肉料理。你嘗過嗎？

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Peco Peco sounds delicious to me. I don't like eating alone, so...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
大嘴鳥聽起來很好吃。我不喜歡一個人吃，所以……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 50 Peco Pecos, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. We all can have a dinner party with Peco Peco cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓50只大嘴鳥，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。我們可以一起開大嘴鳥料理派對。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Being calm is the key to winning important matches.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想贏重要比賽，保持冷靜是關鍵。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
There's not a single cat who hasn't played with Yarn when they were young.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
沒有哪隻貓小時候沒玩過毛線球。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 20 Yarns, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. It will help improve our team's ability.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
找20團毛線，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。這會提升我們隊伍的整體實力。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I have a strong belief that our Manager Cat is taking advantage of our snacks.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我敢肯定，貓管理員在剋扣我們的零食。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
All we need is evidence... Get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們只需要證據……找30條鼠尾，再向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Then, we shall find out whether or not Manager Cat was doing something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這樣就能查清貓管理員有沒有做手腳。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Practice was ok, but I seem to be having a slump these days.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
練習還算順利，不過我最近狀態不太好。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We need to have some Lemon in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這種時候就需要檸檬。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 5 Lemons to our Cat Gamers Director. He'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
給貓玩家協會負責人送5個檸檬。他知道怎麼處理。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets hot easily.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
綿綿島很適合貓咪生活，不過天氣很容易變熱。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
On a hot days like this, we could use some Ice Pieces or Ice Cream.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這麼熱的天，我們需要冰塊或冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
拿10塊冰塊或10個冰淇淋來。貓玩家協會負責人應該知道怎麼處理。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這是貓玩家協會負責人的要求，我就派你去跑一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eryu the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去綿綿島找貓咪埃留，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這是貓玩家協會負責人的要求，我就派你去跑一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Stew the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去綿綿島找貓咪斯圖，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這是貓玩家協會負責人的要求，我就派你去跑一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Ketchup the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去綿綿島找貓咪番茄醬，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這是貓玩家協會負責人的要求，我就派你去跑一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eff the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去綿綿島找貓咪埃夫，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:

Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後向貓玩家協會負責人彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are done with your assigned work.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
完成分配給你的任務後，才能挑戰奪旗遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Not everyone can challenge just because they have the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
不是拿到證書就能挑戰的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Ok, let's practice until a challenger comes!!
scripts.translation:
[首領]
好，我們就練習到有挑戰者來為止！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首領]
要挑戰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are wearing our certificate item. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
必須裝備我們的證書才能挑戰奪旗遊戲，請之後再來。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
The Flag Game is only available once a day.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
奪旗遊戲一天只能參加一次。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首領]
要挑戰嗎？

scripts.text: Challenge.
scripts.translation: 發起挑戰

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Ask about the rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Let's challenge the Flag Game. Please wait while our cats get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
來挑戰奪旗遊戲吧。請稍等，我們的貓咪正在準備。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Oh! I retired from 'Cat Gamers', and am working on a national game referee license. Licenses are the new trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
哦！我已經退出“貓玩家”了，現在正在考國家級遊戲裁判證。最近考證很流行。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
A referee must use standard language... So it was very hard for me to stop crying meow meow~ like other cats.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
裁判必須使用標準用語……所以我很難像其他貓那樣喵喵叫。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
I know the game rules for players for sure, but refereeing the game is a lot harder than it seems.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
我當然懂選手要遵守的規則，但當裁判可比看起來難多了。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Sometimes I do make mistakes, and people go crazy like it's the end of world. What a hard job this is.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
有時我也會犯錯，大家卻像天塌了一樣鬧起來。這工作真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, I want to finish this course, and be the world's best referee ever.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
不過我想完成這門課程，成為有史以來最出色的裁判。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You can bet on it!!
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你就等著看吧！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Allow me to explain the rule for the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
讓我來說明奪旗遊戲的規則。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You play with 5 other cats.
Wait and wave the flag when no others are waving it.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你會和另外五隻貓一起比賽。
等其他貓都沒揮旗時，再揮動你的旗子。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You start with 5 Flag Points, and each time you wave the flag 1 point vanishes.
When your points hit 0, the game ends.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
開始時你有五點旗分，每揮一次旗就會扣一點。
旗分歸零時，遊戲結束。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
There's a special rule for this Flag Game. For more thrill, we reduce 1 point if you do not wave your flag for 10 games.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
奪旗遊戲還有一條特別規則：為了增加刺激感，如果連續十局不揮旗，就會扣一點旗分。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You will get bigger presents as you win with less Flag Points used.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
獲勝時剩下的旗分越多，獎品就越豐厚。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Come back anytime if you need more help with the game rules. Our Manager Cat is also available for some help with the game rules.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
如果還想了解遊戲規則，隨時可以回來問我。貓管理員也能為你解答。

scripts.text:

Cats are now all prepared.
What will you do?

貓咪們都準備好了。

恭喜你贏得了奪旗遊戲。

scripts.translation:
[首領]
不過你在比賽中沒怎麼參與，所以獎品只有3罐罐頭食品。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I'm hungry. Any rats wandering around?
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
啊～我餓了。附近有老鼠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I think I could eat 100 cramps at once.
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
啊～我覺得一口氣能吃下一百隻藍鼠。

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Hey, why don't you look around? Who knows? Maybe we can find a delicious canned food~
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
喂，四處找找看吧。說不定能找到好吃的罐頭呢～

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

到時候分我一罐吧。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:

我餓了～還有剩下的罐頭嗎？

scripts.text:
[Row]
Hut! Human, you came to see me, Row the Great? What? No?
scripts.translation:
[羅]
嘿！人類，你是來看偉大的羅的嗎？什麼？不是？

scripts.text:
[Row]
What do want then? Get lost. Ah...!!
scripts.translation:
[羅]
那你想幹什麼？快滾。啊……！！

scripts.text:
[Row]
You want to play the Flag Game? I see. Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[羅]
想玩奪旗嗎？知道了，讓我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[Row]
But, you know you can never beat me, the great Row.
scripts.translation:
[羅]
不過你知道吧？你絕不可能贏過偉大的羅。

scripts.text:
[Row]
Flag waving is a serious game. Only special cats like me can compete. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[羅]
奪旗可是很認真的比賽。只有我這樣的特別貓咪才有資格參加，喵～

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Hair picking is my best hobby meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛是我最喜歡的消遣，喵。

scripts.text:

When picking hair meow~
Time really flies meow~
scripts.translation:

拔毛的時候，喵～
時間過得真快，喵～

scripts.text:

Come here, you, meow. I'll pick your hair meow.
scripts.translation:

過來，喵。我來幫你拔毛，喵。

scripts.text: The cat is picking your hair.
scripts.translation: 貓咪正在拔你的毛。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Arrgg!! Why should I play this stupid flag waving game here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
啊啊！！我為什麼要在這裡玩這種蠢透了的奪旗遊戲？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Hey you. What do you think? I know you've hearing me!
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
喂，你在想什麼？我知道你一直在聽！

[利布斯]
……

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Well, I'm sure you won't have a clue why this is happening. I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
我猜你也不明白這是怎麼回事。算了，我原諒你。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
How can a human understand the overwhelming heart of cats.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人類怎麼可能理解貓咪那顆強烈的心呢？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
A human? What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人類？你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Oh! I see. Our director is looking a practicing partner, why don't you apply?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
哦，原來如此。協會負責人正在找練習搭檔，你怎麼不去報名？

scripts.text:

Meow~ I'm annoyed meow~

[勇勇]
喵～煩死了，喵～

scripts.text:

[勇勇]

[烏尼特]
哇哦～今天真忙啊～
哦，你就是拿到榮譽證書的那位？

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
There are more orders coming every day. Ahh!! Give me some more manpower!!
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
每天都有更多訂單。啊啊！！再多給我派些人手吧！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Certificate complete!!
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
喵～哦～證書做好了！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I already gave your certificate to the Cat Gamers Director! Go check it out~
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我已經把證書交給貓玩家協會負責人了！去找他看看吧～

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Please... Keep this wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
請……無論去哪兒都把它帶在身上。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I am a cat. Nyah~ Ong~
I look like a sheep because I was so busy I didn't have time to shave.
It is not my fault...
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我可是貓，喵～哦～
我看起來像只羊，是因為忙得沒時間剃毛。
這可不是我的錯……

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Do not interrupt my resting.
Usually, I am very busy...
Don't touch me.
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
喵～哦～別打擾我休息。
我平時可是很忙的……
別碰我。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I'm a bit fat now, but you should look at yourself too. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我現在是有點胖，不過你也該照照鏡子。哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
I want join 'Cat Gamers'.
But it seems the Cat Gamers Director is busy now. Should I just leave?
scripts.translation:
[面試的貓]
我想加入“貓玩家”。
不過協會負責人好像很忙，我要不要直接走掉？

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
What? You also want join this group?
scripts.translation:
[面試的貓]
什麼？你也想加入這個組織？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
Why did someone put that vase inside of a glass?
The Cat Gamers Director did that?
scripts.translation:
[等候的貓]
為什麼有人把花瓶放進玻璃罩裡？
是貓玩家協會負責人乾的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
What strange taste.
Maybe I should rethink joining 'Cat Gamers', huh?
scripts.translation:
[等候的貓]
品味真奇怪。
我是不是該重新考慮要不要加入“貓玩家”？

scripts.text: ^0000FFThere's a hastily written message on this bulletin board.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF公告板上貼著一張匆忙寫下的告示。^000000

scripts.text: A fallen angel within will unlock a hidden enchantment to Archangel Wings.
scripts.translation: 裡面的墮天使可以為大天使之翼解鎖隱藏附魔。

scripts.text: You are carrying too many items, please reduce them and come back!
scripts.translation: 你的物品帶得太多了，請整理後再來！

scripts.text: You have overweight, please reduce it and come back!
scripts.translation: 你的負重過高，請減輕負重後再來！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
You seem like a poor guy!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
你看起來很窮啊！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
If you have an Archangel Wing, I will enchant my capability into the useless 4th slot. Would you like me to do so?
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
如果你有大天使之翼，我可以把自己的力量附魔到那個沒用的第四欄位上。要我這麼做嗎？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text: Enchant Initialization
scripts.translation: 重置附魔

scripts.text: Stop speaking
scripts.translation: 別說了

scripts.text: What are you going to do?
scripts.translation: 你要做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can enchant my capability into your Archangel Wing if you pay 1,000,000 zeny. But you can't enchant it again without resetting it.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
支付1,000,000 Zeny，我就能把自己的力量附魔到你的大天使之翼上。不過不先重置的話，就不能再次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The enchantment is dangerous, so ^ff0000the wing might be damaged^000000! Nevertheless, my good blessing will retain the ^0000ffcard and refine level^0000ff!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
附魔很危險，^ff0000翅膀可能會損壞^000000！不過在我的祝福下，^0000ff卡片和精煉等級會保留下來^0000ff！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
沒錢的話我可沒法幫你！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
There are 2 important notices. First, the enchantment requires ^0000ff1,000,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
有兩點要特別說明。第一，附魔需要^0000ff1,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Second, ^ff0000although the rate is not high, the Archangel Wing might be damaged^000000! This is very unlucky!
If you can accept these conditions, I will enchant the wing for you.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
第二，^ff0000雖然機率不高，大天使之翼仍有可能損壞^000000！運氣實在不好！
如果你能接受這些條件，我就為你附魔。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下……

scripts.text: I accept, let's enchant!
scripts.translation: 我接受，開始附魔吧！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
好！你慢慢考慮！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
大天使之翼已經取下來了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Don't take off the item!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
不要把裝備脫下來！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This Archangel Wing is enchanted! Please initialize it or bring another Archangel Wing for me!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
這件大天使之翼已經附魔了！請先重置，或者再帶一件大天使之翼來！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Be merciful to the survivor,
Send flowers to the dead.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
善待倖存者，
為逝者獻花。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Help for justice,
Elimination of evil.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
扶助正義，
剷除邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
But the important point is... the Archangel Wing is damaged!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
不過最重要的是……大天使之翼損壞了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
I believe that you will become the dominator of the new world!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
拿著吧！
我相信你會成為新世界的霸主！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Initialization requires ^0000ff3 units of Silvervine Fruit^000000. The wing will not be damaged except for the enchanted capability.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
重置需要^0000ff3個獼猴桃果實^000000。除了附魔的能力外，翅膀不會受損。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下……

scripts.text: Ok, I want initialize it.
scripts.translation: 好，我要重置。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
好！你慢慢考慮！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
大天使之翼已經取下來了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Oh... you have unequipped the Archangel Wing!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
哦……你把大天使之翼脫下來了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
沒錢的話我可沒法幫你！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This equipment has not been enchanted, please check it again!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
這件裝備尚未附魔，請再確認一下！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
拿著吧！
